Once I looked out my window, what was seen has left me convinced, confused and wanting to know more about what it is exactly, that I saw.  I live out on a cattle farm, and on that particular night the cattle were in the field from which I saw the UFO.  It appeared to me as a very large, round light about the size of a softball, that was swirling with many different colors; purple, pink, red, green, orange that could have resembled a head lamp in its movements.  
The light floated in mid air for about 30 seconds as I watched it, then suddenly vanished moving to the east and appeared to enter the shadow/body of a single cow.  This sounds highly unlikely and crazy at that, but I know what I have seen and no one can tell me that it was a drone or anything human.  
About two or three days after the sighting, while walking through the field, I came across the remains of a cow, missing its entire skull, clean cut- this could have been due to coyotes/birds of prey, etc., but for whatever the reason those two events to me seem as if they may be related in some strange way.

summary: Slightly oval bright white light about the size of a full moon traveling at an extremely high rate of speed.  Happened very quickly.
description:
I walked out of my house around 1:15 am and looked up and seen a bright white light which was slightly oval traveling at an extremely high rate of speed.  It seemed to be relatively low, I honestly cannot determine the exact elevation because it happened so quickly.  It headed in a south west direction.  
My first rational thought was a shooting star (I have seen hundreds of shooting stars/meteorites before), but this was about the size of a full moon in the sky and left no trail behind it.  I have never seen anything like it before and would love to know the explanation.

summary: It looked like a firework but it didn't explode like a firework.
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Was watching a movie in bed, facing the window, looking towards the eastern skyline, when a streak of bright white light went downwards.
description:
Looked outside to see if there was someone on the ground with a flashlight, but there was nobody there.  
No other streams happened afterwards.  The stream started out strong and then faded rather quickly.  
Happened sometime between 1:00 am and 1:20 am.

summary: Glowing ball of light as low as a landing plane, shooting across the sky as fast as a bullet.
description: I walked outside and this object completely drew my attention.  It was a glowing ball of light, yellowish gold,, the color and shape of a street light/lamp post.  Shot across the sky as fast as a shooting star only this was as low as a plane landing, maybe even lower.  I'm used to seeing planes from Logan, but this was unlike anything I have ever seen in my life.  It shot across the sky until it went over the skyline, where I lost it.

summary: Several rapid moving objects!
description:
Went outside to let dog go potty.  I was looking south towards the sky.  I noticed at least 4 or more strange thing moving in the sky.  I got my camera that has 16x zoom lens.  As I zoomed in on the objects they were darting back and forth left to right.  
I told my partner to come out and look.  She witnessed it also.  
I was able to get some pics by setting the shutter speed.  And when I looked at them on my TV, it blew my mind.  I know it was not a star or stars but something I cannot explain!
Witness elects to provide no contact information.  PD

summary: I saw a triangular object with a light trail behind it move REALLY FAST through the sky.
description:
I saw a triangular object with a light trail behind it move REALLY FAST through the sky, way faster than I have ever seen a plane move.  It was so fast it almost seemed like a comet, but the object was a defined shape. 
It flew out of my line of sight even though I tried to walk quickly to see what it was.

summary: 6-8 orange red lights in a horizontal line flying above at low altitude, and low air speed.
description: 6-8 orange lights in a horizontal line.  The event lasted about a minute, the lights flew over at relatively low altitude, and low air speed.  They were traveling about as fast as a helicopter.  The lights produced a sound similar to a flock of geese flying above.

summary: Loud, low noise near Newark, DE ...then 4 oOo shaped lights in sky above in formation....then the helios show up.
description:
My son and I heard it at the exact same time, because we looked at each other immediately.  We didn't talk, I just jumped to the window ans threw up the shade.  
I saw nothing but a faint orang-ish glow.  It shook our walls, it was very loud and very low and no sound either of us could identify hearing before.  The closest description would be "rocket."  
I then went into the backyard, we live away from city glow and have a better nightscape.  
I then see 4 light formations if I was thr middle pointing up and out with both arms to either direction one would be at each pointer fingertip and another at each pinky tip.  Cigar shaped, but 3 lights mainly, one large and 2 smaller on either side.  
No movement. like so oOo      oOo              oOo      oOo lights seemed bright white. 
Strange. 5 minutes after "noise" 5-10 helios began flying around in the area.

summary: Red and white blinking lights that zig-zagged at a high rate of speed above Cylon Wildlife Area.
description:
Seen a blinking red light that was zig-zagging then started blinking white very fast and moving at a very fast speed, then seen one very large flash of light, then left the area.
Witness elects to provide no contact information.  PD

summary: I witnessed about 8 reddish glowing lights in the sky.  They hovered in an oblong horizontal pattern and then shifted into more of a vertical pattern.
description:
I was trying to capture them on video with my phone.  I was able to catch one on video before it disappeared.
We have amended the time, to reflect a nighttime sighting.  Witness later corrected both the time and date to 20:35 hrs. on November 03rd, 2015.  PD

summary: Illinois Valley green fireball.
description: Standing in backyard with my dog and saw what appeared to be a green fireball with a red tail jet through the sky!!!  Traveled east to west...it was awesome!!!

summary: Witnessed a fast moving small blue light across sky to the horizon.
description:
I witnessed an event in the sky on 03 November, 2015, @ approximately 1730 PST in Bremerton, WA.
During this evening, I was traveling southbound on highway 303 and saw a faint light blue in color round object traveling North to South at a high rate of speed.  It was traveling slower than a meteorite, but faster than a satellite across the sky.
From my perspective while driving, I saw it travel in front of me from the top of windshield to the horizon directly in front in approximately 3 seconds.

summary: A very bright glowing light looked as if it was crashing into the ground then vanished into the ground somewhere.
description:
A bright glowing circle light beam looked as if it was crashing out of the sky very fast, then vanished into the ground area!
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: On November 03, 2015 at approximately 1950 hours, while working in the capacity of a police officer, myself (Detective Sergeant) and two other officers (both K-9 officers) witnessed several bright…
description:
While standing on Wilson Ave. and Snyder on the boarder of Campbell and Struthers, Ohio, witnesses observed 2 triangular shaped objects in the northwest sky.  Witness B was the first to notice them and advised the other two witnesses.  All looked to the northwestern sky to see 2 seemingly equilateral triangular-shaped objects with lights at each angle.  The lights appeared to be an unwavering bright lime-green, with one light forward and the other two in the rear.  
Due to the limited amount of stars in the night sky, witnesses were unable to determine at this time if the objects were solid or not.  The 2 triangular objects were traveling at a very low speed from northeast to southwest.  The two objects were also traveling very close together.  At this time the 2 objects had crossed over the Wilson Ave. reference point when witnesses observed a single, lime-green in color, orb-like object following the same flight path, but seemingly lower than the other two.  At this time t! he two triangular shaped objects further crossed the Mahoning River reference point, and began to spread out.  The lead tip light stayed slightly ahead while the two rear lights moved up and further apart,…

summary: Two dark triangles spotted in West Seattle.
description:
I was walking my dog in west seattle, up by High Point looking out towards the Puget Sound and saw a dark form cross the sky and it immediately caught my eye.  It was dark and flat and I thought it may have been a large bird at first then I noticed dim white lights at the tips which formed triangles. 
The lights formed what looked like the outline of two dark triangles that were overlapping each other looking almost like one object.  
Then they disappeared behind some clouds as they were moving across the sky quite quickly.
It was definitely like nothing I have ever seen before!

summary: Bright light low in the sky, suddenly shot off in a straight line and disappeared.
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Triangle shaped bright green fast travelling sighting.
description:
Bright green forward facing triangle zipped quickly through the sky before dipping downwards in an arc shape out of sight.  Lasted approx 5 seconds.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Solid, dark-gray, triangle-shaped craft that hovered and flew without any sound.
description:
As my friend and I were driving west on Hyw 52, entering Portland city limits on the west side of town, we saw a triangle shaped craft headed our way, moving west from the east, directly over the hwy.  It seemed to hover and it made no sound at all!  It finally began to move as we drove under it.  
The craft did not bank as a plane would when it turned to change directions.  It remained level and simple turned and slowly drifted off to the north.  It stopped when we quickly turned around and as we approached it again I flashed my head lights franticly and it seemed to know that we were attempting to follow it.  
As we got under the craft, that was approximately 100 feet above us, it took off at high speed and as it was leaving, F-18s flew over us at a high rate of speed in pursuit of the triangle-shaped craft.  We watched until they all were out of sight.  
The craft had two white lights on the back side of the triangle craft and a bright red light at the front (nose) of the craft.  It was a dark gray color and completely solid.  
I am retired Army and have been stationed at Ft. Campbell 101st Airborne/Air Assault Division and have seen all the high tech special ops aircraft in…

summary: Looked like Venus but then faded out
description:
At about 6:30 PM, I was sitting outside, looking up 45 degrees from the horizon to the south, and saw what looked like the planet, Venus, because of its brightness, and was stationary.  
As I was looking at it after about 10 seconds it started fading out to a brightness of a dim star.  Eventually I couldn’t see it anymore.  
I don’t think it was a plane because it stayed in the same spot.
I’d like to know what that was.  Do you know of any idea what that could have been?

summary: V shaped, silent, no lights, transparent object seen for 30 seconds on 11/3/2015 at 6:45 pm.
description:
My husband and I had stepped outside, on a crystal clear night to look for northern lights.  He saw a v shaped object, and said do you see that?  I said yes, I DO see that!  It was v shaped, no lights, totally silent, and transparent.  
It appeared to be about 800 to 1500 ft up.  He thought it was a flock of migrating birds, I said, birds don't migrate at night, and they make noise.  All the geese are gone by this late in the fall, and are very noisy. 
It appeared to be gliding, if that makes sense.  
We continued to watch it, having conversation the entire time, until it was out of range.  About 30 seconds.  
I don't know what it was, but I know we both watched it in length.  Only one object was observed.

summary: Above the Shennandoah Valley, a bright light high in the sky moved north to south at approximately dusk on 11/03..
description: Facing east, with the sun just set behind me, I had just got out of my car when I noticed an extremely light high in the sky almost directly overhead at approximately 80 to 85 degrees.   Moving north to south, it was moving at a pretty fast clip, but much too slow or large to be a meteor (no tail either), and it appeared much higher in the sky than any of the other aircraft (of which there were at least 4 that I noticed).  The sky was clear and with the sun having just set I initially thought the brightness was just a satellite reflecting the sun, but as it moved from south to north it dimmed, and in under a minute was completely gone.  I stood watching the sky for a few more minutes in case the light returned, but nothing was visible again along the object's path during the next 5 minutes.

summary: Disc shaped object with an orange light movig through the sky in a NE direction.
description:
Object first appeared as a slow moving orange light.  I first thought it was a plane but the light was orange and not flashing.  Upon looking closer, I noticed it had a saucer type shape. It was moving slowly in a NE direction.  A tree in my yard starting obstructing my view.  In the couple seconds it took for me to move to the other side of the tree, it was gone.
Also of note, there was something large moving in the woods below my house as I was watching the light.  I could hear some branches breaking and dry leaves rustling.  This could have been a bear though since I do sometimes see them around here.
After seeing this, I called a friend and my cell phone was acting up.  He said it seemed like what I was saying was being repeated several times in different voices.

summary: Two shiny orbs east Scottsdale, AZ.
description:
I'm at work and I see 2 bright shiny orbs over Scottsdale and they slowly headed east over the mountains.  Before they started moving, they stayed close to central and Bethany for a short period, and then took off towards Scottsdale.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Keizer, OR, south to north saw a ball of light fly through the sky for approximately 5 seconds before it disappeared.  No sound, just a fast moving ball of light.
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Fast ball of light, no streaks, odd direction, disappeared.
description:
My husband and I saw something around 11:30pm in Midway, Arkansas, on 11/02/2015.  A light that shot down/across the sky at a speed I can only describe as unhumanly possible.  
No streaks behind the light, no flashing, just a bright ball of light that seemed unnatural.  It was foggy is some spots but the sky was and still is clear.  
No clouds, moon was half way exposed.  
We were driving home and both saw it at the same time we didn't even get out the phrase, "What the hell is THAT?!" before it was gone.  
By the time we realized what happened it was far too late for photos or video.  It was, simply put, incredible.

summary: Sphere shaped object with red striped lights in back and white lights Flashing around the sphere;flying towards Quonset.
description: Arrowhead shaped. We stepped outside and saw this very large light in the sky.   Determined right away it wasn't a plane; there were two other planes up much higher in the sky.  We watched as it approached.  There was no sound coming from it.  It had these red striped lights on the back and white lights flashing around the sphere shape.  It traveled towards Quonset.

summary: Three lights faded in and out of view, changed from a triangle to a line formation, and disappeared.
description:
Seen these once before from my east-facing window.  Three lights appeared in a triangle formation, faded in and out of view, changed to a straight line formation, and then faded away again.  They don't move much once in formation, they just hover. 
Took several pictures as evidence, but of course they don't show much, as I couldn't see much myself.

summary: at least 15 orange discs that formed a V formation with a tail.
description:
I was on my balcony smoking and was looking up for shooting stars and looked up over my house to the southwest and saw at least 15 flying discs that each had a bright orange light. 
My jaw dropped and I saw that they were flying in a V formation with some coming backwards from the apex of the V and curved around to the right making what looked like a tail off the right side of the V formation.  They were gliding through the air effortlessly with no sound. 
They headed southwest in the sky and traveled out of my line of sight.  
It was truly amazing to witness and it was very beautiful and majestic.

summary: 11/02/2015 Above St. 79BT, Boeung Tumpun, Phnom Penh, Cambodia - yellow orange fire - 10 sec - the last 4seconds it went directly upward.
description:
On the night of Nov 2, 2015, I was sitting on a balcony located at a building on St. 79BT, Boeung Tumpun, Phnom Penh, Cambodia, and as I looked up into the night sky, I saw an object glowing something like a yellow orange fire color emitted from a rocket engine.   From my position, I estimate the object appeared to be at an altitude somewhere between 20,000' and 30,000', and it looked to have a diameter of about 1.5m to 2m.  
I called another person who was nearby in the building, but as I did that, the UFO glow increased and it started ascending rapidly which could be detected by the manner in which its size now reduced rapidly and within 4 seconds it was completely out of my visual sight range.  The UFO went virtually straight upwards.  There was no other sign of movement in any other direction, it went directly up.  
The following are the co-ordinates for PHNOM PENH - Latitude: 11.55° N  Longitude: 104.92° E Elevation: 16 m - the location from where this sighting was made on Street 79BT is approx 0.5km due South of the Soviet Khmer Friendship Hospital.

summary: Spot light turned off, triangle pattern lights, helicopter noise, dog bark, shooting stars
description:
Was playing disc golf at night with lights and from the peek of hole 2 we saw a spot light above some trees in the hole 12 area.  It sounded like a helicopter.  It turned off the spot light and it had more of a spinning sound.  Could see blue lights that seemed to move in a triangle shape.  There was a red light in the middle.  My dog started barking as it got closer. He has never barked at an air craft before.  This course is in the country around some farms. We sometimes play at a course near the air port and he has never barked.  We saw shooting starts through out the night.
I was stunned by the sight so much I thought I should grab my phone but could not look away.  It was near us then just a light in the distance heading south.
My friend and I decided it was not a normal craft and it had to be something from the government or a UFO.
Sort of sounded like what this person described: 
http://www.nuforc.org/webreports/123/S123336.html  
I didn't remember the exact night but I know it was that week I listed this.  I just found this site and I have never felt more sure what I saw was not normal.

summary: Object looked like it was on fire.  There was no sound.
description:
My husband and I were walking the dogs when he saw this bright light down the street. I initially thought it was one of those luminaries since it seemed like it was on fire.  
I realized quickly that it wasn't because it was moving too fast and there was no wind.  We watched it until we couldn't see it anymore.  
We continued our walk and not 5 minutes later, we saw the object come back!  We again watched it move to the east until we could no longer see it.  
The object was flying lower than any plane yet there was no sound coming from it.

summary: Purple light hovered in sky before flying off rapidly to the south.
description:
Me and girlfriend walking down dark road to look at stars.  Saw a purple light to the South East of town. It would hover, and dance from side to side.  
Seemed very far away, but moved with a very agile speed.  It would hover for minutes at a time before shooting off again.  
It disappeared southward (down?) over the horizon. 5 minutes later it shot back up, briefly hung in the air before distinctly pulsing red twice, and then going down over the horizon again.

summary: Bright shooting object
description:
Driving down Route 3 leaving Tewksbury, when a bright light STREAKED THROUGH the sky and burned up.  Bright light, appeared bigger than a normal "shooting star."
Possible meteor??  PD

summary: Saw 2 different types of lights in the sky in Marion, IN
description:
My boyfriend and I were walking to his parents about a block away.  The first lights we saw were on the way there.  We live outside of the city so we get an amazing sky view.  First we saw 1 white light that didn't flash at all like the airplanes and looked about twice the size.  There was no sound and it changed direction and speed about 3 times before disappearing suddenly.  We saw a second one far to the right behaving in the same way but going different directions.  When it went to the far right we could hear dogs begin to bark from the same direction.
We get to his parents and we're there for awhile visiting and eating.  We leave and just as we head down the road, he says, "I hope we get to see something else," an a bright orange "shooting star" shoots through the sky and appears to explode and disappear as it falls.  Did anyone else see this?  Please report it so we know we're not the only ones.

summary: Four white-yellow lights moving across the sky over Lake Michigan at incredibly fast speeds.
description:
Walking to a beach on Lake Michigan, my companion and I watched as four white-yellow lights flew across the sky.  At first we believed them to be at the bottom of some aircraft, but it was zipping across the night sky at a relatively quick pace.  The lights had a southbound direction.  
At some point, the lights moved in such as way that the imaginary craft they were connected to was no longer parallel with the earth (horizontally aligned) but as if it were perpendicular to the earth (vertically aligned).  
The lights then converged together.  They began to corkscrew rapid in the night sky before flying off in that corkscrew fashion in a southeastern direction.

summary: Bright light hovers then zooms away near Grand Rapids GRR Airport.
description:
One bright light, intensity about 3 times brighter than brightest planet on most nights, appeared in the southern sky just as the stars were coming out.  
Light did not move, but glowed bright white, intensified, then as it began to fade, or dim, it zoomed off in an upward and southeastern direction, fading to nothing as it got further on it's trajectory.  Similar to one I spotted winter 2014-15 in same area.

summary: Dark chevron/boomerang object
description:
Saw a chevron/boomerang shaped craft gliding southbound toward city park.  It was silent and couldn't have been flying higher than 250 feet, difficult to tell since it was such a barely visible object with no lights.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Spotted very bright (brighter than Venus or Sirius) light 12 degrees above the Northeast horizon that was mostly stationary for approximately 2 hours.  There was however some movement detected by eye…
description:
A red light was flashing alternating with another color that was more difficult to define...possibly light green.  Witnessed by myself as well as my wife.  Sky was very clear. The object was too distant to determine a shape.  The movement was easy to see but was quite limited in extent.  It basically hovered in the same spot for 2 hours at which point I gave up trying to determine what it was.  
Of note I text messaged a male Operating room nurse that I work with and he confirmed and gave the same description as me. It was roughly near where Capella in Auriga would be looking from Tahlequah, Oklahoma, but was not Capella!!  I have 27 years of experience looking at Capella from Tahlequah and this was much, much brighter, with a flashing red light.  
Of note it made the local news but my wife said the recording cut off and she therefore did not catch any details except that someone did videotape the object in the Northeast.  The object rose to about 20 degrees above the horizon for a while (2 fist widths at arm's length).

summary: Just north of DFW airport, many planes were in line in the air with full white lights on and in between ones landing and the next plane's descent, I saw a green light slowly illuminate in a oval…
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Changing red and lime green orb seen in the western sky of Plainfield, IL.
description:
In the western sky, just after sunset, a bright lime green circular orb jettisoned into the sky at a rapid speed.  It then sped in a horizontal direction across the sky, sometimes changing colors to a bright red.  At other times, it would hover in one spot.  Eventually it completely disappeared.
About 3 minutes later, it approached the same area in the sky, but this time it came speeding from the south.  It was flying both in a horizontal and vertical pattern at rapid speeds, all the time changing from bright red to lime green.  Although this seems like it could be the red and green lights of any plane, the formation it moved and the color it changed were unlike a plane.  Again, it would just hover at certain times and eventually it disappeared.
While continuing to watch, a bright white light came out of the south.  This appeared to be plane, as we have planes flying to Midway or O'Hare nightly.  However this plane came speeding to the same area of the sky, circled the exact location of the changing orb and then sped off to the north.

summary: Two objects that brighten to 1st magnitude and dim to be no longer visible in southeast sky
description:
From 6 pm or earlier, my husband and I sat on our deck viewing the southeastern sky during twilight from our deck.  
Around 6:14 pm two objects (appearing starlike) began to gradually increase in brightness in proximity to Neptune's current location and about 3 degrees north of Fomalhaut (1st magnitude star in Piscis, according to my iphone app Star Guide.)  
The two objects were about 1 degree apart and gradually brightened to become the brightest objects in the twilight sky, then dimmed until they were no longer visible by naked eye.  The visibility period lasted about 3 to 4 minutes, from 6:14 to 6:18. 
They did not appear to change location.  
Perhaps these were two fixed satellites that momentarily caught sunlight.  But I am not sure.

summary: Big silent green flash over Corona main street area.
description: Big green flash over main street area that made no noise.  After the flash the sprinkling rain turned into a pour.  Stayed for several minutes after trying to get footage, but there was only the one initial flash during that time.

summary: Triangular shaped craft with bright lights on all 3 sides observed in the Copley/Medina area.
description:
Saw a triangular shaped craft that made a loud humming noise, descend then maintain elevation and hover over an area to the north that was still within sight range.  After a few minutes it disappeared.  The craft had lights along each part of the triangular shape.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Triangular neutral-silvery  object with 3 circular illuminations in each corner on the underside seen for 15 minutes
description:
Cleveland east side, November 2, 2015 : Bright object about 60 degree angle seen in the northeast sky at 4:20 pm.  I observed for it a good solid 4 minutes while it did nothing but remain stationary high up in the sky. It did not shift, bounce, vibrate, or jiggle. My husband ran in the house and came out with binoculars which we used to view the object. We were able to see that it was clearly a triangle shape, that it was a rather neutral looking silvery color, and that it had 3 distinct circular illuminations located near each corner on the underside.  The illuminating light was white and  bright. The light never blinked, but was continuous. We viewed the object for a total time of 15 minutes from when I first noticed it.
It appeared to stay in one place, but several times as I viewed it through the binoculars, I was able to see it rotate as it stayed in the exact same place.
Then it seemed to go higher and get smaller. From my vantage point, it appeared to go slightly north as it got smaller.
There was no sound, no trail, & no ongoing linear movement.  It mostly appeared to hover, then go higher as I previously mentioned.
Witness elects to provide no contact information.  PD

summary: I saw about 5 to 9 round objects with white reflections or bright lights flying north from Tijuana to San Diego, they crossed over and kept heading north.  They were flying at an approximate…
description:
In order to see the flying objects I had to focus my vision into the sky and stare at it until I was able to spot them.  They moved at a steady pace not too fast but not slow either.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: We where on the interstate when I look up at the sky to see it so clear blue with clouds in the distance when I saw a bright light that resembled a planet.  I then point it out to my husband and ask…
description:
As he keeps glancing at it, the light begins to fade out slowly and then before we know it vanishes.  Very odd it happen so quickly I didn't think to take pictures and it was gone before we knew it.  It looked just like a planet it was a bright white light no haze or tail or trail left behind, but a circle of light thay faded to nothing.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Witnessed a strange dark circle in the sky,during the daytime hours
description:
On, or about Nov. 2-5 2015 early in the evening 4pm -5pm I stepped out onto my back porch area. I glanced up when I saw some birds flying by, and something unusual caught my eye.  By definition it appeared to be a UFO.  It was flying, and it was some type of object I couldn’t identify.  I ran back into the apartment and grabbed my camera.  Not bothering to check the settings I put it on video mode and began recording.
	It appeared to be a perfect circle, and was completely black. It didn’t make any sound and was moving very slowly due north.  I was able to follow the object for about 49 seconds before it slowly drifted down and disappeared behind some trees.  I didn’t have any idea of what to do with the video.  Feeling that it would be ridiculed I kept it to myself.
	When I came across this site I decided that this would be a safe place to post it.  I always believed that UFO’s are real, but this is the first time I witnessed such an event.  I do not claim to know exactly what it is that I saw, but it is available for scrutiny, and perhaps someone can tell me what it is.
	The guess work on the date and time is due to the fact that perhaps after changing the batteries, I never…

summary: Object in East Minneapolis sky shoots into view of my window horizontally, stops dead, shoots upward seemingly into space.
description:
Object flew into my peripheral vision in the East sky (from Downtown Minneapolis).  I realized it was not a plane, as it was moving too quickly, and that it was not a bird as it looked to be too far away and was flying too straight.  
As I turned my head to focus on the object it stopped dead and shot off and incredible speed, seemingly upward into space.  
The object was far away, oval in shape, and I couldn't tell what color it was.  There was no sound and I didn't notice any environmental effects.  
I was basically just laying on my couch watching television when I noticed it out the window to my left.  It frightened me.

summary: Saw a white orb fly past the house, silently disappearing.
description:
My dad and I were looking at a tree with bees all over it, then saw a white orb like craft fly very quickly overhead and past the house.  
We quickly ran around the house to try and follow it but it very quickly disappeared toward the north towards Denver.

summary: Multiple ufos in formation sighted
description:
As i was looking around on the roof of a 9 floored building I noticed a number of objects moving across the sky above me, each one trailing another in the form a giant caterpillar. They had a yellow glow and had a haze around them. 
After crossing 3/4 of the sky they formed a "V," and 4-5 seconds later, they again formed a caterpillar shape and then faded. 
They were moving and manoeuvring too fast for any human made craft I had ever seen.  But they didn't make any sound.  
They seemed to be flying very high.

summary: Bright white light with flashing colored lights -   hovering then appearing to drop about 50 feet then zooming back up.  Then it would
description: My husband and I observed a bright white light that flickered red, orange and yellow,  hovering and zig-zagging high in the sky north of us - perhaps over Burlington area.  This is the third time over two years that we've observed this in the sky.  There were just a few stars observable this night and this object definitely stood out in the dark sky - and it moved about quite a bit. The shape of the orb seemed more disk like at this point and it changed direction from south to west - a maneuver that both my friend and I had not seen any planes or helicopters do.  The dim, grey disk moved slowly and we thought we had lost sight of it, but it was distinct and clearly not something we were used to seeing move in the night sky.  It changed direction from west to south again, but appeared to move away from us instead of closer as it had when it was bright red... and then we lost sight of it.

summary: My daughter and I were paced by a formation of craft for about ten miles.
description: At approximately 9 p.m. on Saturday, October 31, 2015, my daughter and I were driving south on Hwy 43 towards Columbia, TN when we saw 4 bright blue-white lights in the sky on the driver's side of the car. They were approximately 50 feet in the air. At first we thought they were lighting up a haunted attraction for Halloween, but after looking a bit longer we noticed there were points of more concentrated lights at each corner, so the light source was coming from above, not the ground. They maintained a square shape, and looked like 4 lights, but occasionally a light would travel from one corner to another in a random fashion, so there may have been as many as 8 lights total. They were ahead of us at first on the left, but as we approached the main intersection of Hwy 43 with Hwy 31 the lights were keeping pace with us. My daughter snapped a couple of photos with her phone. We crossed the intersection and the lights were still pacing us, as they continued to do for several more miles. Then I looked back over and they were not there. We were relieved, but a few minutes later they were slightly ahead of us, kept pace for at least 5 more miles, then disappeared.

summary: My bedroom window faces the backyard, which is full of wild aloe, trees, bushes, NO houses, NO roads.
description:
Just prior to sunrise, I was awakened by bright lights.  At first I thought it was a car driving by, but then wondered what car, there's no road or house outside of my window.  
So then I thought it may have been a flashlight?  Was there someone outside of my window?  
About a minute later I saw three circular white lights in line with each other and a single on beneath flashing through my bedroom window's curtain; this was definitely not a flashlight.   
I was too frightened to look out the window.  The lights didn't return once the sun rose. Found this website and previous posts lead me to believe what I saw. 
Did anyone else see these? This is the second occurrence.

I found some similar pictures on Google and people were calling it a UFO.  Also, found another post in Florida of someone experiencing what sounds like the same thing.  Interesting.
We suspect that the witness may have been observing a "twinkling" star.  PD

summary: Bright crown shaped object sitting stationary in the clear mid day sky, shrinks to a spot and then disappears. Happens 3 times
description:
Approximately 16:45, Driving on I-70 south bound with my 10 yr old son, clear blue sky, we noticed a round spot in the sky, looked like a star however it must have been far brighter because it was so clearly seen in the day time.  After approximately 5 seconds it disappeared.  
We see jets in the sky on a daily basis so we were trying to figure out how this spot could have been a jet when we saw a crown shaped object, 5-10x larger than the spot, once again as bright, sitting motionless in the sky approximately where the spot had been previously.  
It remained there for some time as my son and I talked and tried to figure out what it could possibly be.  Then it shrunk down to a spot, like the one we had seen originally, and then disappeared.  
We couldn't figure what would be so bright and sit stationary in the sky like that when suddenly it appeared again.  Again we watched and racked our brains to try and figure out what it could possibly be when again it shrunk to the spot for a few seconds and then disappeared.  
When the bright crown shape appeared the third time in approximately the same place in the sky I let off the gas and almost coasted to a stop, staring and not…

summary: Strange light high in the sky over the water several times a week.

It’s a very bright flickering light that looks diamond shaped sometimes and triangular in shape other times.  I’m not sure what town it’s actually over but I assume it might be New Haven but could be as far away as Branford or even Guilford.  I usually see it between 2am and 4am and it’s usually out there for at least 1 hour before disappearing. It’s always high in the sky and does not move for that particular night, however every night that I see it, it’s not always in the same location that it was the prior night when seen.  
For the past 2 nights there were 2 of these lights out there not far from each other.  I’m really not sure what these lights are but there is something out there and just wanted to report it.

summary: I walked outside tonight when my boyfriend called for me to come see a strange light from the perspective of our front driveway.  I saw a bright glowing saturated orange orb hover in the night sky.

Also, the light was glowing from within -- it wasn't directional or a "beam" of light, so it didn't look like a small aircraft or a drone.  And it didn't have any blinking lights on it.  It looked like a bright orange fireball that was somewhat stationary, but moving very intentionally at times. 
I was in awe of this glowing ball and overwhelmed. It finally glowed really bright and flickered once, became instantly smaller, and then faded out to a small dot and disappeared as if it had quickly zoomed away. 
We tried to capture it on our iPad and iphone, with one poor quality image to show for it.

summary: Two building-sized shapes floating slowly west to east along Lake Ontario waterfront south of Hurontario. Oct 29, 1:30pm, 2015

I saw two rectangular shapes moving slowly from west to east.  They seemed to follow the lake front. They were higher than buildings, so perhaps 40-100 stories or higher in the air.  They were the size of 6 story buildings.. very large rectangles in comparison to nearby buildings.  I watched carefully but I could not see any airplanes or helicopters that would be pulling them.  They flew in formation, very slowly.  I watched as they flew from directly south in line with Hurontario, to perhaps Long Branch.  They were dark, perhaps black.  There was a slight cutout on the right (West) edge, starting at mid-height, going down to the bottom-right corner of the rectangle.  Both shapes had the same thin cutout. summary: Tulsa UfO with amazing flight path at speed.
description:
I am a factually based MD radiologist practicing in a major medical center.  I have never had an experience of this nature.
I was sitting in a hot tub shortly before dawn, when a more delta-like boomerang shaped object with a round apex and sharper back corners came into view far away on the eastern horizon.  It had no running lights, and was only faintly identifiable in the night sky as a vague pearlescent entity.  There were no clouds in the sky.  
At first, I thought it was an ultralight, but it was so high that the shape never changed as it migrated from my 12 o'clock to my 4 o'clock position in a straight line.  There was no sound.
At the 4 o'clock  position, it made a severe 90 degree turn south with no indication of banking or change in shape.  The turn was executed as a smooth alteration in course occurring in a space of approximately 2-3 times the width of the object with no change in speed.  It headed south for 2-3 more seconds and then disappeared from sight abruptly without any preceding alteration in speed or direction.

summary: The object was shaped like a "W," but replace the two connected V's with two crescent shapes, and had no visible lights.
description:
At approximately 19:25, my neighbor and I were outside chatting about the World Series.
We began to discuss the fact that the local university is broadcasting the World Series on the Jumbotron at the football stadium on campus.  I glanced up at the sky in the general direction of the stadium, and saw a very large, seemingly partially materialized object low in the sky for the duration of approximately 5 seconds.  It made no noise as it moved in a southwesterly direction, with no visible light emitted from the object.  Wagering a guess of its size, I would say it was at least the size of a football field.  No reference to the aforementioned football field intended.
The object was shaped like a "W", but replace the two connected V's with two crescent shapes.  My neighbor saw it too, and said it looked like a flock of geese.  I have never seen geese fly in a formation other than a "V" shape.  However, I can also state my neighbor is not the smartest person on this planet, as he was calling a baseball "inning" an "ending" as we spoke tonight.  Perhaps it was a flock of geese, but I thought this worth reporting.

summary: Orange Light Pairs, 8 to 9-pm CDT, 10-28-2015.
description:
On October 28, 2015, between 8 and 9-pm CDT, it was dark and I was returning from a 45-minute walk.
I went through the Lake Highlands Baptist Church parking lot, at the intersection of Northcliff Drive and Parkhurst Drive.
This Church is about 1-mile northeast of White Rock Lake in northeast Dallas, Texas.
Directly to my southwest, about 20-degrees above the horizon, were about twelve orange lights, forming about six distinct pairs.
The lights were each uniformly as bright as a full Venus, but were pure orange in color.
No FAA aircraft navigation colors were visible, specifically white, red and green.
The lights appeared to be over the Fair Park area, at about 5,000-feet in altitude and 5-miles distance.

Each two lights appeared to be mated, but I could not see any solid object between the lights.

Driving south on IL 130 north of Villa Grove IL.  Saw light in low lying clouds.  From a distance it appeared stationary.  I thought it was a light on top of a tower.  
As I approached it, I noticed a farmer in his field working after dark.  The object was hovering above the farmer in a low lying cloud.  The object appeared to have two bright lights aiming north.  Although the object was hovering, it was also slowly moving northward.  
It could have been a helicopter but if not, I have no idea what it was.  It was not a star, a planet, an airplane, or a jet.  I would have pulled over and watched it but I had my wife and kids in the car.  She told me to move my ass down the road.  She said I was going to get us all killed.  Always wanted to see a UFO.  I think I finally saw one and I didn't get to enjoy it.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate.  PD

summary: Unfamiliar green light pattern traveling on a straight line that stopped in flight and reversed direction.
description: I saw a set of green constant airplane lights coming toward me and the Burbank, Airport landing path that I reside underneath.  This was an unusual color pattern and direction so I mentioned it to the man I was talking to.  As the green lights came closer, traveling on a straight line North East towards the South West the 'plane' appeared to be gaining altitude and just as my friend noted that it appeared to be increasing speed when... suddenly it just stopped. It did not slow down nor turn, Just stopped and reversed direction as if it were a film running backwards.  It was NOT spectacular but the green light pattern and the flight path were clearly unusual before we saw it stop motion and change direction.  The lights continued to look the same from the new angle as it moved away. It appeared to be lower in the sky than space. Like an airplane.  Definitely not a helicopter and more than likely too big and fast to have been a drone of any kind.  I am still in awe of the fact it just stopped in mid air.  I had a clear view.  It was almost overhead when it reversed and then returned across the horizon and disappeared from my view behind some buildings.

summary: Four large circular lights rotating at high speed above cloud cover for over 50 minutes.
description: At approximately 7:10, I noticed four hazy circular lights that appeared to be above the cloud cover.  They were directly over our property or slightly north.  They formed one light, and then it split into four lights diverging from the center light to form a large circular motion.  Each of the four lights rotated counter-clockwise about ¼ of the circular pattern at high speed.  Then the four lights merged into one light again.  They continued to follow this pattern. I immediately called my wife out to observe.  The pattern barely moved northeast in the ten minutes we were observing.  As of 7:45, the lights continue. Holding my thumb at arms length, they appeared to be about the size of a quarter.  There are no beams originating from the ground as you would expect from searchlights.  I tried to video, but nothing showed up.

summary: 10-24-2015 17:02. Odd moving shinny object in the sky near Wilsonville,  Possible UFO.
description:
There was an air balloon flying near Wilsonville, Oregon, on October 24, 2015, at around 5 pm, I was looking at it and the surrounding sky, when I was looking at the southern sky area I noticed a "shiny object" near a cloud that moved "odd," it was still for a little while and then turned in a circular manner changing direction towards the north (Portland, OR), it moved for a little while going north, the object stopped and hovered near another cloud, it stay there for another while, then kept moving again towards the north until it was no longer visible.  
The object was WAY up in the sky, it looked shinny, possibly metallic, and had a roundish shape, it was way up there so couldn't really make out any specific details.  I had a camcorder with me and was so excited I was watching a "UFO", I thought I was recording the object, but unfortunately forgot to push the record button, only got a tiny segment and some frames, it was very difficult to see on the camcorder anyways.  A friend was walking with me, I told him to look, he got to see the object too, not just me.
I'm reporting it just in case someone else might have seen the same object in the sky around the same time.

summary: Bright object appeared in the sky and traveled from point A to Point B in what seemed to be instantaneous.

When I say instantly, I mean instantly. Point A to Point B in what seemed to be faster than a lightning bolt making contact with the ground.
It was very bright.  Almost pure white.
My friend saw it too, however we were the only two to notice in the group. 
We were at a music festival so there was a large crowd. I am unsure if anyone else saw it other than us.  We verified that it was not a camera flash because there were nobody with a camera in the direction we were looking.

summary: Silent, very bright ball of light, silent, instantly disappeared

Immediately, a very, very bright light in the sky caught my eye; it looked like several powerful LED lights.  I stared at it for 30 seconds or so and just assumed it was a helicopter or plane and made another cast.  I looked back once again after approximately a minute or so and it had gotten closer and even brighter, but with absolutely no sound.  It was essentially just a silent ball of light moving slowly.  Out of nowhere, it literally disappeared instantly while I was staring at it for the second time.  While I don't know how long this thing was in the sky, from the time that I spotted it to it disappearing was around 3 minutes.  Anyhow, I have seen Chinese lanterns and what not and this was certainly nothing like that; it was the biggest/brightest light that I have ever seen in the sky.

description:
Star gazing at 7:15pm EST 10-18-15,  I spotted a white lighted moving object traveling North North West at 75-80 degrees off the horizon, that made no sound.  At first I thought it was a slow moving satellite.  41 29 73 14.
It did the impossible.  Moved in a consistent line a few degrees, one finger at arms length then abruptly stopped totally, and reversed its direction.  Then came back and went varying directions,  north,  south, east, and west each time reversing its directions.  At times it appeared to be hovering.
Not real bright but easily visible.
I’ve seen the Space Station several nights but it moved along in a consistent direction and pretty good speed.  This was not as bright appeared smaller, and moved more slowly.
At one point it was moving with a pattern of repeating printed MMMM’s, forming somewhat of a wave pattern.
Nothing I know of can maneuver in air in this manner with a sharp or reversing turn at the end of each run.  Nothing.
Could have been an object buffeted by winds but very peculiar.
5-7 minutes duration of observation, then I stopped viewing.  Ran for the computer to see what this might be.

I don’t think it was a Mylar balloon because it moved smoothly east with no deviation or bobbing.  It was quite high in the sky and my rough guess is that it would have been about 25 to 30 feet in diameter.    
I slowed my vehicle and watched it move steadily across the sky.  I found a place to pull over and after parking my vehicle, I tried to find it again and it was gone.  The sky was clear, no clouds and no trees or other obstructions.  It should have been there because it wasn’t moving very fast.  It was just gone!  
The total length of my observation was probably 45 seconds to a minute.

The object/light also moved many different directions, almost in a distorted figure-8 pattern. It was about 70 degrees above the horizon & while it moved, it covered an area of about 15-20degrees of the sky.  It was seen to the south and eventually we lost sight of it as it moved towards the east and was blocked by branches of trees around us.
Absolutely no sound was heard & although the sky was crystal clear at the time, no solid object could be seen, just the flash of light.
So curious to see if anyone else saw this and/or if there's an explanation for this sighting.

summary: Bright, hovering purple/green light that turned red and slowly fell to the ground.

It was definitely not a plane.  It seemed lower to the ground than any plane I've seen in the sky. Then, as I was waiting at the red light the purple/green light turned red, hovered around a little more and then looked like it slowly started falling to the ground and out of sight behind the buildings, etc..  I didn't see any more of it after that, as I turned and was driving to the west.  However, I did keep checking to the south.

It was moving extremely slow (moving South/heading North) and although it was probably higher, it appeared to be off the ground at just above cottonwood tree height.  
As this object continued to move the orange light reduced down to (for its size ratio) a pinpoint and then its light seemed to disappear.  
What was also interesting about this strange, flying object, was its dark, massive size which became more apparent with the reduction of its orange light.  And, there was no sound emanating from the object.  This flying object certainly gave us pause and caused us to question what kind of aircraft it could possibly be.

summary: rectangular ufo seen flying overhead, while driving down residential street in Lakewood, Colorado
description:
I was driving down 1st Avenue towards Sheridan, from Wadsworth.  I noticed what I thought was an extremely bright star in the sky.  It struck me as odd because I didn’t see any other stars in the sky that night.  I was driving so I couldn’t look very closely, but I kept glancing at it and realized it was flying.  I assumed it was a plane.  
Then, I stopped at a red light and was able to really look.  I realized that instead of two lights on the wings, like a plane has, it was one solid band of extremely bright light.  It was coming in faster than a plane, and flying too low. 
As it came closer, and was about to fly over me I saw that the band of light was coming from the bottom of the ship, not the front.  It was gliding rather than flying.  I saw it from a slightly diagonal angle when it came really close and noticed it was an extremely flat craft, with a bronze like top and darker outer edges.  I looked straight up at the bottom of it when it flew by, and it was covered in many very large bright lights, shining out from behind some sort of see through pane.  It kept flying in that direction, and that is all I saw.

summary: I saw 6 bright reddish lights traveling from northwest to southeast flying in a strange pattern.  At firts I thought a plane was crashing and I was seeing wing lights move vertical.

We pulled over and counted almost 20 go by.  We could not make out a shape against the night sky.  They looked like balls of light.  They were pretty low.  We thought maybe they were  military helicopters but they were completely silent.  They seemed too large to be drones.  We tried to find the source by driving in the direction they seemed to come from.  We noticed a large bright flash on the ground level to the sky.  It was a pinkish flash like the same color as a flare but over a huge area the size of a football field.

As I watched this object shine, it was stationary at the time that I first observed it, as time passed it seemed to move away from me, still could see it rotate in the blue sky until I could barely make it out, when I lost site of it.  It was just gone.

summary: 'Unidentified Ground Object' Spotted in Northwest, Washington, DC
description:
I was walking in my backyard towards my driveway when my cat, who was also in the backyard, suddenly froze staring at the base of a tree.  It then took a few steps backwards, turned around, and ran full speed to the door on the other side of the house (to be let back inside).  I looked around the tree to see what had frightened the cat, but there was nothing there, so I turned and took a few steps away, but decided to quickly look back one last time.  That's when I saw this object running from the tree to behind the trash barrels located near the end of the driveway.  It was about 12-15 ft. from me and in my direct line of sight on a bright, sunny day.  I was very startled, and decided to first let the cat back into the house.  A few minutes later I walked over to the trash barrels, but there was nothing there.
The object appeared to 2 dimensional (like a geometrically shaped cardboard cutout), and it seemed able to camouflage itself (like a cuttlefish, or something I'd expect to be created in a DARPA lab).   The object’s legs appeared to be moving rapidly, but it’s movement was comparatively slow as if it wasn’t getting good traction.  The object was approximately 18 inches tall.…

Witness 1:  	A friend and I were at Spring Canyon Park, Fort Collins CO, having a conversation, when I noticed what appeared to be a kite like object gliding through the air above me.  I could barely distinguish it from the darkness of the sky, but I could see it enough to determine a shape.  
It was a V-shape with five dark grey circles, two on either side and one in the middle.  It was maybe 500 feet in the air and moving slightly faster than that of a plane making absolutely no noise.  
My friend did not notice this first sighting, so I took him to the other side of park in hopes that it would return.  
At 8:15pm, we both noticed what looked like a similar craft to that of the first sighting gliding north to south more to the west then the original craft.  We then decided to lay down and sk watch hoping to see another craft.  At 8:27pm we noticed a very large craft roughly 500 feet in the air. It flew northwest to southeast directly over us at a  lower altitude than the other two crafts and this time it flashed many intricate small lights…

I then stopped at a red light and it was still moving.  When I turned it kept following me, but eventually disappeared behind the woods after a minute or so.

description:
My wife and I were on vacation in Scottsdale, AZ, and traveled to Sedona for the day.  We took many photos from our cell phones (16MB camera) when there.  A few days ago we copied the photos to our computer, and on the larger screen were able to notice what looks to us like a saucer shaped UFO above the mountain in the attached photo.  My wife took the photo.  Not knowing what she had photographed, I took the same view / photo within a minute later with my camera phone (both Samsung S5's), mine is stamped 3:30 pm (local time) and the object cannot be seen.  We are pretty certain there was not any debris on the camera lens, we’ve never had debris on any of our photos and have taken thousands.  
This is a recognizable mountain in the area, but I can’t tell you exactly where we were, or which way we were facing.  I really wish I had Geo-tagging turned on when the photo was taken!

summary: Two very large objects reflecting the afternoon sunlight hanging just above the clouds in the sky west of Baltimore.

That’s when I noticed the first object, which was hanging just above the clouds and gleaming in the sunlight far more brightly than they were.  It was also angular, which made it stand out from the clouds.
	I noticed the second object, just like the first, a little farther beyond it.  They appeared to be stationary.  The clouds passing beneath them, they’d reemerge in the same spot.  At one point a passenger jet passed below the clouds but still at some distance between me and the closer of these two objects, and then I realized how unbelievably large they must have been.
	They seemed to be taller than they were wide.  And as I traveled round them, turning to the north, I saw their shape from another angle.  What appeared at first to be a box with a triangular projection below it became something like a very large “X” shape, with the upper legs being much taller than the bottom ones.  Then, viewed from the north, the side facing the sun appeared to be curved, almost like a sphere with a smaller sphere projecting below it.…

I am in the habit of driving out to the intermodal and shooting random video of activity in and around the yard (opened in 2012).  I don't always view my footage, unless something extra was observed. I didn't "see" anything so I didn't view this tape until some number of days, maybe months later.  And I noticed the bright "flame" streaking through my view, as the camera was focusing in on some flying geese.  I have always been a UFO "buff" observing a couple of interesting events over the years.  But nothing really reportable and no photo/video.  For whatever reason I have procrastinated doing anything with this video, figuring it probably isn't anything anyway. summary: Large green orb defied physics.
description:
October 2015.  Work 3rd shift, left for work approximately 11:15 pm.  Drove around ¼ mile from driveway, and upon passing the end of a wooded area, my attention was drawn to my right and up, over a large, open tobacco field. (Approx. 22 acres).  There was an illuminated green orb that looked akin to a Christmas tree ornament (the mirrored ball type) hovering at an estimated altitude of 1000-1500ft AGL.  
The orb appeared to be 30-45ft in diameter.  I would guess the distance from my vehicle horizontally to be about 150 yards, as I had to lean over the steering wheel and look up through the windshield to keep the object in view.  
I witnessed the object remain at a dead stop, hovering, for about 15 seconds, before it began to accelerate away from me in a straight line.  It accelerated slowly, at first, but smoothly gained speed so tremendous that before it had even reached the horizon, it disappeared.  Was undoubtedly NOT natural phenomena.

I live south east of Mauna Kea, and watched the object from when it appeared as a pinpoint over Manua Kea, north of my position.  To win it disappeared behind the trees just south of me passing over the active Kilauea Volcano, at its closest point to me it seemed to be about half the size of the moon and bright orange with no discernible shape, or running lights.  It was also dead silent.  I was stunned.  Sound travels really well over the bush at that time of night and this was uncanny.  Much to my surprise a second object appeared immediately after following the same course identical and silent, about one minute later.  I watched in amazement and still can't believe what I saw.

Then the lights goes off, you see nothing, then comes back on at the dim level twice before vanishing.  Another one came about 30 seconds later doing roughly the same pattern. All moving up and down, with the last 2 veering further to the right, near where the first two vanished.  It wasn't long before several obvious airplanes flew across the sky in the same vicinity. There were more than 12 objects (so many I stopped counting at 12) bunched together in the sky.  They were disk-like objects with red, green, and white lights.  The lights were mostly white.  They came down quickly.  It was almost like a sudden drop then they darted off in different directions.  
As I continued driving home, I still saw them; however, they were more spaced out. We were about 8 miles from an airport at the time of the sighting. I am sure that these were not planes; however, it is possible that planes were in the area at that time.  I would assume that the airport would have noticed something. Because of the flashing side lights, I initially thought it was an airplane, and it was just extra bright against the dark sky.  But as we got closer to it, the white light was bigger, and it appeared that the light was hovering in place, not moving. I then thought maybe it was a warning light attached to a tower, as there are many along I-70 West, although the warning lights are typically all white or all red.
As we drove by it, it was not over the highway, but off to the side over the trees and fields.  I was able to see it briefly because I was driving.  I looked up at it and could see underneath. It was not attached to a tower, but was a rectangle shape that seemed to be standing still in the sky.  It did not have the body shape of an airplane and there were no wings.  The bulk of the…

The night sky was clear, weather 52 degrees, no wind, no planes or man made objects in the sky.  The white light was larger than any star in the sky and had a brilliance I can only report as a fusion burst.  The light would flash, then reappear in a different location within the star cluster. Heading earthward, this object or ball of energy was brilliant green and emitted a white glow or halo followed by a "tail."  It was observed in the south Oxnard sky. I then ran inside to grab my phone but was unable to get in time to get any footage.  I ran to the street in front of my home to see them far in the distance down the street, the orbs now heading south west.  One orb faded while the other seemed to hover for a while, fading after around 20 seconds.  
I work on commercial aircraft almost every day, I saw no machine just two orbs of red light.  It is a surprisingly clear night here in Halifax, so I have no reference to size or altitude.  They approached very quickly and were too far to film in the 20 seconds it took to get my camera.

summary: I saw an orangey red, slightly flattened horizontally sphere moving silently, south to north, at a constant speed and altitude.
description:
My wife and I saw an orange-red spherical globe while watching tv at our lakefront cottage on Lake Huron.  The sky was mostly clear, the breeze had been from the west all day and the night was cool, but not cold.
Sphere was slightly flattened horizontally and emitted its own glowing red-orange light. Light was constant, did not flicker or change intensity. No sound from it or the wind - even the trees were silent.  Speed was constant.  It seemed to just float along but with the breeze coming from its side.  It did not change altitude either but moved in a straight line from south (land) to north (lake).  At one point, far out over the lake, it faded out, promptly re-appeared and then disappeared completely as if it went behind a cloud bank.  Size and distance were not discernable but if I held out my arm to full length the globe would have been about the size of the end of my thumb.  The whole sighting lasted well under two minutes.

Disappeared over lake, perhaps into clouds but very clear night.  No sound. Sighting lasted approx one to one and a half minutes and was witnessed by two people who caught sight of it moving past a window, who then ran outside to follow its flight out over Lake Huron.  Both are retired teachers and keen environmentalists.

We live in the flight path of Newark and JFK airports so jets in our night sky are an common thing but this was different than any plane/jet I've ever seen.  
I'm also an amateur astronomer and have been for over 40 years and have seen everything from bolide meteors, satellites, all the naked eye planets, auroras, comets and to many other astronomical items to list but what I saw last night baffles me.

3-4 lights moving in an erratic manner while also moving as a whole unit in a creeping sort of manner toward the north.
description:
At first glance, it just looked like a little cluster of stars, but they were a little dimmer than all the rest.  I should also mention that the sky was VERY clear tonight and the moon wasn’t in a spot where the sunlight reflection would drown out all the stars so it was really easy to see the sky.
The little cluster of dimly lit stars looked normal until I looked at it through peripheral vision, and then it looked like, a sort of cloudy mass with tiny pinprick bright spots in it.  The longer I looked at it, the more I could see that the little lights were moving around in a really weird, erratic manner.  There would be three, they’d make a sort of triangle shape, but then there would be four, and it would look like they formed a straight line, then they’d all kind of disperse and not be any kind of shape really but they’d be moving around a little bit and it kind of made me think of the way gnats swarm around in groups.  And the cloudy area behind it, along with the lights themselves, all seemed to be moving as a whole in one direction (possibly north) in a slow, creeping sort of way.  My partner and I believe this is the first time either of us have witnessed a UFO.

Also, there had been a helicopter circling around the sighting for about an hour before the sighting and is still hovering around that same location now, about an hour after the sighting.  It is flying way too high to be a police chopper searching for a suspect on the ground.
For the record, I never believed in UFOs and typically have categorized those who do as crazy/stupid.  This is my first UFO sighting, and it was quite bizarre.

There were about 10-12 of these objects.  I would really like to find out what so many people all over the world have witnessed daily in so many different states and countries.

summary: An orange sphere of intense and steady light moving steadily across a black night sky; 56 second phone video.

I noticed a very bright, steady, orange light out over the ocean.  The moon was not in the hemisphere, and there were no noticeable clouds.  The day had clear skies. Winds were calm.
When I opened the sliding door, I noticed that the light was slowly moving towards the east, towards the shore, at an even speed and steady altitude.  I would guess it was above a thousand feet.
The light was not a pin-point, but a distinct round shape.  I looked for a cowling shadow or surface reflection, but could see none.
The round light was intense, but not like a searchlight, there was no beam effect.  There was no strobe or flutter effect, either.  I was able to catch a smartphone video of 56 seconds.  The video shows some strobing, but that is mostly due to the auto-focus of the phone trying to maintain focus on a light source in the dark.
At 3 seconds in I zoom to maximum, hence the greater distortion and apparent change in size.
At 31 seconds the light moves behind the row of motel…

summary: 2-6 orbs of light intersect, then "bounce," reverse direction, turn, then "bounce" again for >15 minutes.

They were heading towards each other then, once they intersected, they both headed back in the reverse direction.  Soon there were three orbs, then 4, then 5, then 6.  Again, the orbs would head in the same direction, intersect, then reverse direction (or “bounce”).  The number of orbs visible at any one time varied from 2-6.  The orbs stayed in almost continuous motion.  However, at times the orbs seemed to stop and hover in a loose pattern for a moment, only to resume the “bounce” activity.  I did not notice any distinct shapes formed by the orbs.  The only clear cut pattern was the “bounce” activity that remained consistent.  There was no noise in my area before, during or after the sighting.  I shot still and video photography with my I-Phone.  I managed to capture images of the activity as described above. summary: Large light appears and disrupts vehicle power.
description:
I was traveling southbound on Mopac (aka Tx Loop 1), about to exit for HWY 360 Capitol of Texas.  
It was 4:36 am when my 1999 Brown Chevy Astro abruptly turned off.  I attempted to turn the key but had zero power.  
That's when a large light, partially obscured by light clouds, appeared and remained motionless.  
I stepped out of my vehicle and took a picture with my smartphone.  I attempted to access the video recorder, but the light increased its intensity and grew to 4 or 5 times the size of a full moon, before rapidly vanishing.  
This light created no sound, no heat, and no wind.  It did not pulse, flash, or change colors. It merely appeared, grew larger and brighter, and then disappeared.  
I remained outside of my vehicle for 3 or 4 more minutes, but the light did not reappear.  I got back in my car and it started.  
I have no damage to the car, or any other devices that were with me at the time.
We spoke via telephone with the witness on two occasions, and he seemed to us to be quite eloquent, rational, and sober-minded.  We suspect that he is a very good, and reliable, witness.  PD

summary: Shooting Star?
description:
I live in Garland, TX, a Northeastern suburb of Dallas County.
I was sitting in my patio, facing North.  I sit out there and enjoy a cigar a couple of times a month.
It was approximately 8:00 P.M. and I had just taken a puff of my smoke and tilted my head back to exhale.  As I did, I saw what I thought was a "shooting star", going North.  I have seen meteors/shooting stars on many occasions and thought no different.  I could distinctly make out "flames" on this and thought I had a great view of a meteorite streaking across the evening sky.
The "flames" diminished and I could see something that looked like a star, moving across the sky.
From my vantage point it looked like a star, except that it was moving.  I then saw another "star" coming from the other direction, heading South.  This object was perhaps a little brighter than the North-bound "shooting star".
The two star-looking objects came together and slowly faded out.
I do not believe they were stars. I called The National UFO Reporting Center immediately.
End of Report.

I watched for about 30 seconds, and it dimmed by about 75% and started moving slowly north.  After 10 minutes the object was about 80 degrees west and 70 degrees off the horizon.  
I ran inside to get my binoculars and when I got back outside it took me about 5 minutes to find the object again as it had dimmed again to a point barely visible to the naked eye. 
The object was about 40 degrees N.E. and still 70 degrees off the horizon.  
At that moment, a bright flash came from the object.  It was as if a large camera flashed.  I followed the object with my binoculars as it moved E.N.E.  Slowly, and every minute or so, the object flashed brightly.  In all, I saw eight flashes as the object moved E.N.E. and out of my sight.

At the same time the "V" appeared to be dropping, not going away from me as an aircraft should.  Then another "star" appeared in a different area of the sky, but still around the "V".  
Once again it repeated the cycle as the one before it: bright, dim, then disappeared.  By the time I got to my exit at 30th and Dodge, a third "star" was starting what appeared to be the same cycle, but I lost it after the horizon went behind the tree line by Boystown/Creighton hospital.  By the time I got to the top of Cuming and 40th the "V" was starting to go below the tree line further west without any more sightings of the "stars."  During the drive from Council Bluffs the "star" locations were as follows:  9 o'clock of the "V",  6 o'clock of the "V" and 3 o'clock of the "V", almost exactly.

Suddenly, it started moving towards us very quickly, until it was directly in front of us over the highway about 100 yards in front of us.  We could not discern a definite shape, but we felt it was triangular and had an angled top which narrowed in what appeared to be the front of the flying object.  There were three sets of bright lights, with several lights in each set.  My daughter thought the bottom of the object was slightly rounded.  The entire sighting took approximately 15 seconds.  
As the object reached the Western side of the freeway, it appeared to hesitate and “wobble”, continued into the desert about 50 feet and completely disappeared.  It was a very bright night, with a full moon.  There was no visible propulsion; the craft simply disappeared.
We spoke via telephone with the witness, and we found her to be quite sincere and sober-minded.  We suspect that she is a very good witness.  PD

Looking up I noticed a "fireball" flying over the tree above us.  Seemed to have some aura coming off of it.  It was reddish/orange.  Directly overhead it was clearest.  That was when I immediately though "fireball".  As it got further away it took on more of a disc shape and became a darker red.
Minutes later another flew over from the same direction.  Exactly the same.  Then two more maybe 10 minutes later.  A few minutes later another two. Another 10 minutes or so came another two.  Showing up as two they were never side by side, always one before the other flying on the same flight path.
The last two came one by one again like the first two (not paired) minutes between them.  All in all it lasted from 11pm-11:45pm (central).
All I had with me was my cell phone but I shot three videos in the highest quality I could.  You can see a perfect disc shape as it got further away.  Zoomed way out in one of the videos to show houses for a little perspective.
As an avid sky watcher I always have my eyes peeled!

They seemed fairly low, and I assumed they were the lights of a low-flying small aircraft. I continued driving, forgetting about the lights for a short while…a minute, perhaps two.  When I looked again I could not see them even though I would have expected to still see an airplane.  I thought they might have been lights that reflected in my car, how sometimes the headlights of another car can reflect in strange places inside your own vehicle.  But traffic was very sparse and there were no street lights or such.
Within a couple of minutes I again saw lights in the sky, maybe ten or twelve scattered within a span of about 40 degrees to the left and front of my vehicle.  My recollection of detail is not good, but I recall them going in different directions, mostly slowly.  Some blinked…

They stayed in the sky over the south for a few hours, they continuously moved back and fourth but mostly they just hovered in the sky.  At this point two of my neighbor's came outside and witnessed the lights as well.  
Once ten o'clock rolled around, the fireballs slowly, one by one, started to flicker and disappear.  Once the last two were almost gone suddenly multiple man made aircrafts were seen flying in the area with lights, shining them through the clouds in the same spots the fireballs were hovering at.  Since then the birds in the vicinity of where the lights were, have been acting very strange.  They seem as though they are spooked, they seemed almost nervous.
They were obviously looking for what we had seen, the lights are usually there every night at the same time they've even been seen during the day.

summary: Red and white light flying erratically and very fast
description:

It hovered in place for 10 to 15 seconds, then descended in a very rapid spiral pattern almost to the horizon.  It then immediately zoomed back up to its original altitude, where it proceeded to move in random figure-eight patterns, gaining and losing altitude rapidly.  It moved very quickly - approximately the same speed as someone playing with a laser pointer (except I saw no beam and it was larger than the point of a laser).  
It continued its dance for about 4 to 5 minutes until it disappeared behind some trees in the distance.
We spoke at length via telephone with the witness, and we found him to be exceptionally eloquent and objective, in his description of the sighting.  We suspect that he is a very good witness.  PD
