summary: color changing object over West Texas
description: At 18:02 I observed what I at first thought was a red and silver mylar helium balloon reflecting in the sun as it was tracking roughly southwest to northeast and quickly rising above a residential neighborhood in Big Spring, Texas.  It alternately flashed candy apple red and silver.  I thought the object had primary oval shape as well as much less pronounced rhomboid features between the color changes--maybe like a metallic pin cushion whose sides briefly deformed into smooth planes.  I checked my weather app at 18:03 after I had lost sight of the object, and it indicated winds were 5 mph from the southwest.  The total view time was about thirty seconds before the object seemed to disappear into very faint wispy clouds or haze.  It is difficult to describe the flight path from my point of view because at first it was moving almost parallel to the ground for a few blocks but then, perhaps as it began to pick up speed, it quickly gained altitude while following a s! traight line.  I believe latex helium balloons I am familiar with from childhood would gain altitude along a parabolic path if observed from my vantage.  My guess is the trajectory of the object I saw would be an…

summary: Odd dark & dense cigar shaped object appeared in photo on a farm in Michigan City, IN.
description:
I'm 38 years old, white/blonde female, born and raised in Manhattan, college educated...recently bought a 14 acre farm in Michigan City, IN, next to a 300 acre, unusual soil and plant life nature preserve (Ambler Flatwoods).  
My profession is a Author/Hypnotherapist.  The second witness is my cousin, white male/red hair, 37 years old, college educated.  He works for his father's metal recycling company.  
May, 17, 2015, at approx. 2:40 pm, my cousin and I were sitting by a 1.3 acre pond on my farm property and looking up admiring a very tall tree near by.  I positioned my cell phone to take a picture of the tree - at that time, the sky was clear - no planes, sounds nor birds seen as we were looking up at the tree and surrounding sky.  I saw nothing except sky and the tree through my phone camera as I was trying to position the frame for the best angled shot.  
As soon as I took the photo and checked it, and saw a rather dark and dense cigar/cyclical object with a slight bright "aura" around it very close to the tree's image in the photograph.  I quickly turned to my cousin and said, "What is this??"  
Now, admittedly, I have been interested in ET's and alternative spirituality…

summary: Insanely bright, large circle and electrical warping noises in the San Fernando Valley around 3:21 AM.
description:
May 17th, 2015, around 3:20 A.M.
My friends and I were sitting on Stoney Point just talking and staring off in the distance of SFV, about 25 yards away, the brightest circle of light (bluish white) I had ever seen about the size of an SUV flashed (less than half a second) in the air where we were staring.
After the flash, about a second later, an odd loud electric warping sound occurred.
Never have I heard anything like it or seen anything so bright. The circle of light was the only thing visible and all surroundings were black.  Most historical moment in my teenage life so far and may be most historical event in my life when I’m dead. It became obvious it was NOT an airplane.  The light(s) color was a red-orange and appeared to be multiple lights.  There was no flashing, or green, light as exhibited in an airplane.  I walked back to the door and told my husband I was looking at something that didn’t look like an airplane.  
I returned to my original position and still observed the odd lights.  I walked off my porch into the yard and it changed direction to the west.  It had originally been approaching from a south-southwest direction.  As I walked off my front porch, the lights became very small and vanished in an instant.
Background:  I worked in the local District Attorney’s Office for 32 years before retiring.   After taking a year off, I decided to use my real estate license, obtained in 2008, and have been working as a Realtor® for the past 4 years. summary: Bright flare arching upward from left to right.

About 1 am, while sitting on a low stool in my front yard, I saw a bright flash, like a flare or beam, arching upward and away from left to right, disappearing over my neighbor's house.  I yelled to advise my family and they told me that it was probably a falling star.  No one else saw it at that time.  
Then, about half an hour later, there was another such object, further to the right. I saw it moving from left to right, also arching upward and away, disappearing over my other neighbor's house.  I yelled loudly as my family was still close; we had a neighborhood gossip session.  
Then I noticed my 4 year old grandaughter and she yelled and pointed that she also saw it.   The object was quiet, very, very bright, like an intense light beam or flare or firecracker-like, moving upward and away, noticeable first just below the top of my neighbor's trees and disappearing above their roof.  
I was sitting in the same place for viewing both of these objects.  They were ! about the same size and each was visible for about five seconds.

summary: Bright shining ball of light moves across sky in Smithfield, RI.
description:
On Friday, May 8th, at 12:05 AM EST, my friend and I were outside, when we saw a bright object overhead.  The object appeared to be circular.  It was very bright, and had the color of yellow/orange with a slight pink/purple tint at the end of it.  It seemed to be relatively close. It moved across the sky for most of the duration we saw, then it dropped a bit, then moved sideways and behind the tree line.  While it moved, there was no trail of light or anything left behind it.  There was also no noise.  
This is unlike anything we’ve ever seen before.  It didn’t resemble an airplane, helicopter, or weather balloon.  
At first we thought it may be an asteroid, but there was no trail of light and it moved in different directions.

summary: large oval on its side with orange bands of light.
description:
At approximately 11:25 p.m., I observed a very large object off the coast, due east of my location.  It was approximately the size of a full moon.  It looked to hold a constant altitude and was slowly moving north to south.  It was shaped like an oval on its side and had bright burnt orange light emanating from it.  
The bands of light were roughly vertical and were moving from left to right on the object.  The light seemed to bend, with the ends of each band curving towards the center.  When the light bands were towards the left side of the object, the ends bent to the right.  When the lights had rotated to the right side of the object, the bands bent to the left.  As the light bands reached towards the center of the object they appeared vertical.  
It was observed during the beginning of a lightning storm a few miles off the coast, just about where the Gulf Stream scoops and towards the coast.  After maybe 15 minutes it quickly faded and the disappeared, possibly into ! the clouds.  Shortly thereafter I heard choppers but saw no lights.  Very strange for around here as we have a lot of air traffic and to run without lights would be extremely risky.  
I tried to snap a picture…

Second glance I saw the second orb trailing behind the first [probably 30 ft. distance] and also descending and getting closer to the River.  This time I tried to figure out their sizes but couldn't really determine it so I guessed that the circumference was about the length of my car [15 ft.?] They continued on their southern path at the same speed.
I slowed down my vehicle to try to get a 3rd and a better look [some Brokeback mountain guy in his Lego set Toyota was honking his horn behind me until he saw me pointing out my window and at the object.  I saw his jaw drop and his eyes open via my rear view as he saw the orbs]  I ignored the driver behind me and looked to see that both orbs came to a complete stop in unison…

summary: Reddish-orange light flying east to west after Salisbury, MD, fireworks.

The light was the size of the navigation lights on a single engine airplane flying at the altitude these airplanes normally fly at.
We are familiar with aircraft lights as we live one mile from the Salisbury Airport and grew up just outside of Andrews AFB.  This light was unlike any aircraft light we are familiar with. Other aircraft were seen landing at the Salisbury Airport earlier that evening.  This did not resemble those at all.
This light resembled a red light I saw over the Atlantic Ocean in November 2014.
I videotaped and photographed this light.

summary: Odd football shaped object seen from Dale Mabry Highway in Tampa, traveling near airliner.
description:
At approximately 2:30, in the afternoon on 05/06/15, I was heading south on Dale Mabry Highway near the Northdale Drive area.  The sky was overcast in patchy sections where there were areas of clear sky between the clouds.  Cloud ceiling looked to be around 6-7000 feet.  
I glanced up at an airliner that was making an approach to Tampa Int'l Airport, traveling on a SSW heading.  I estimate the aircraft's altitude at about 3,500-4000 feet.  As I watched the airliner, I spotted another object drop out of the clouds above and slightly in front of the airliner.  The object was shaped like a football with the ends more narrowly pinched together.  It was uniformly gray in color.  
It described a smooth arc downward for maybe 500' or so, then pulled up and into the next cloud bank.  The sighting lasted only a few seconds, but the object was clearly visible, and I could see the airplane and the object together.  I would estimate the object to be slightly smaller than the airliner so perhaps 100' long.  It had no wings, engines or other visible characteristics or marking.  
Its movement was very smooth and fluid.  I'm not sure if anyone on the aircraft was in a position to see the object…

summary: 2 green lights in front, 2 red in rear late night, moved fast, turned on a dime, went back and forth, straight up an down and silent.

I am 59 and never seen anything move like it.

summary: Two dimmer, low-flying lights flying one in front of the other  at same speed on a northeast path.
description:

We were watching the bat, when I noticed what I thought to be a single craft with two dim, semi-hazy lights located on the front and back.  (No craft was actually visible, just the two lights. If this was a craft, it would be cigar-shaped.)  My roommate whispered, "Oh my god...do you see that?" The lights flew above the bat but below the cloud cover, and were moving at a faster pace than the bat.  They moved at the same speed, without sound.  
Instantly, the lights jumped forward and to the side, changing direction slightly from a northeast-path to a more northerly path. (Based on iPhone compass app, original path was about 60 degrees, and changed to 35 degrees.)  The jump forward in distance was roughly the same length as the distance between the two lights (or, if it was a single craft, the length of the draft, itself.)  After the jump, the two lights kind of vibrated, like if it was one craft, it was wiggling ever so slightly and rather…

summary: Two whitish, yellow lights were following each other with no noise.

They were probably about 2,000-4,000 feet high (definitely lower than the clouds, which were altocumulus clouds, I think and lower than planes).  There was no noise.  
At first I thought it was two birds following each other with the sun reflecting off of them but it was too late for the sun to be a factor and they were traveling way too fast.  Also, it was too late for birds.  At the time I was in my back yard with a clear view of the sky.
Weird.

summary: Sky howling.  Frequency sweep heard, almost like a siren.
description:
10:07. I am at my computer.  I hear sirens outside, but they seem strange so I go to my window to listen, and I realize that the sound is coming from the sky.  The sound would slowly sweep from what sounded like, 900Hz to 230hz and upon reaching the low end jump back up to 900 and restart the sweep.  
The frequency was incredibly smooth, and it had an echo to it.  It was about as loud as a low flying commercial jet liner.  There was also some resonant audible noise behind it.  I rushed to get my camera and run outside but in the 10 seconds that I did that the sound went away.  We've sure been having some strange weather…

Just the solid lights moving slowly off towards the distance.  They were too low to be commercial aircraft, and I have seen military helicopters and private planes fly at this altitude, but there was no sound or flashing beacon light.  
As they got farther away, they just "melted" into the starlit sky.

summary: streaking firey mass
description:
I'm a retired city fireman and forest ranger who served his time in a firetower.  While walking my dog on the evening on Sunday, May 3rd, something bright caught my eye in the NW sky.  At first I observed what I thought was fireworks returning to the ground, but I quickly realized that this was way too big for that.  I witnessed a firey mass streaking to earth.  The mass was multicolored with an extremely long tail.  As it traveled straight down very fast, colorful spark-like pieces were released.  The colors were green, red and yellow and were florescent.  It was quite the sight and was about 3 seconds in duration.
It kept traveling straight to earth so low it appeared it was going to crash, unfortunately it disappeared behind some trees... again, very low.
As a 12 year boy I witnesses a similar object (same color scheme) but it was traveling horizontally and I believed it turned out to be a meteoite I believe.
I never witnessed space junk returning to earth, but I would be willing to bet it looks like my sighting.

My second thought was military as they headed north east and quickly disappearing – the ball of light which seemed like fire became smaller and began to quickly disappear one by one.
About 10 minutes later, I saw them again.  Rising from the same place which seemed like it was from over the lake. summary: Helicopter Follows Orange Ball of Light - San Bernardino, CA.

I went out and observed a large helicopter following a fast moving sphere (ball) of light. The ball was a burnt orange in color, appeared to be approximately ½ the size of the helicopter, and both were traveling from the West in an Eastward direction.
The object was traveling significantly faster and was ahead of the helicopter, approximately 50-100ft away on the South side.  It appeared to slow its speed twice for the helicopter to catch up before they were out of my sight.  
I had a very good view of them as there is a nearly full moon out, the sky was clear, and they flew directly over me.  
A strange and beautiful sight…

A few seconds later, it came back on in full brilliance.

We watched it for over an hour.  It never blinked no sounds and no other lights we seen on the craft at all.  
I used Google skymap to reference known objects in the sky and there is nothing in its location that can be seen without a telescope or as anything more than a small star.  Also the craft did not twinkle it was a bright stationary light.

Looking to the east toward the Mississippi River, at about a 45 degree angle were three reddish orange glows, five times bigger than a star, in a perfect triangular shape sitting stagnant in the sky.  
The lights remained stationary for several minutes as we observed 10-12 more globes coming out of one globe that was the farthest away from the triangle in the southeast moving northwest towards the triangle.  
The globes then began to follow the triangular shape as it moved towards the northwest where they disappeared behind some clouds.  
I would probably say we watched these for ten minutes.

One more blink followed a few seconds later and in a spot slightly further away than the last, again, as though it were travelling towards us.  Then the blinking stopped all together.  This lasted about 10 seconds total.  
I kept my eye in this area of the sky for at about three minutes and even looked in the approximate line of travel and didn’t see the light again.  It was like the light was turned off or whatever was creating the light disappeared completely.  
Approximately five minutes after that sighting, I kept looking in a western direction but scanned over towards the north, then saw one blink while looking in that direction.  Again I kept looking for several minutes in this area of the sky, but didn’t see any more blinking like that there…however an…

My two girls and I were leaving family's house in Renton, heading toward Kent, when we saw a HUGE fiery-red object in the Southern sky.  
The object was cylindrical in shape, had a very bright red, hazy aura around it, and as it descended, it seemed to stretch out, as if it were moving so fast it left a streak across the sky. 
Before it dropped, it hovered for approximately 30 seconds while we watched.  
I don't know how long it was there before we came upon it, but after about 30 seconds, maybe a little more, it rapidly shot downward to the ground.

summary: Brilliant orange object, followed by another one 10 seconds later, then phased out.
description:
I live in Chittenango, NY, and in the western sky over Syracuse, I observed these objects.  The first one caught my eye because of the unusual bright orange color.  It showed up a little below what I think is the planet Venus, one of the brightest stars in the sky right now.  It was coming toward me at a slight angle.  
Size and intensity both slightly greater than Venus.  Witnessed it on a straight trajectory that lasted for 12 to 15 seconds.  Grew in size slightly as it approached.  Flew a distance of 6 inches on a ruler if held at arm's length across the sky before "phasing out" over 2 to 3 seconds.  
About 10 seconds later a second one "phased in", flew the same trajectory for the same distance and time and then also phased out. Perfectly clear night, absolutely no sound, the brightest objects in the sky short of the full moon in the opposite side of the sky. The moon was blocked out to a sliver with a very sharp shape.  As I observed the moon, thinking it was supposed to be about 3/4 from full, the disk began heading east with the clouds leaving the moon at it's appropriate size. 
As the disk (guessing at about 1000 ft in diameter) traveled above the clouds, it was going slower than the clouds, but it's shape was clearly visible through the clouds as a perfect disk and unlit.  
I realized what I was seeing was the shadow on the clouds from the moon.  After about two minutes, it veered north and passed across some clear areas and appeared as a huge very black disk against a lighter sky and blocked out every star above it until it passed letting me once again see them.  
This took about 4-5 min., until it passed over a thick bodied cloud and was then gone from view.

A buddy and I were driving home from Madras, south on US highway 97 when I (the passenger) saw a giant, bright gold/yellow colored orb flash very low in the sky/horizon.  This light flashed at exact intervals moving north, back toward Madras, about 10 miles away--this all happened in roughly 10 seconds.  My friend also saw the light flash a few times when he looked through the rear window of our truck, at its furthest point until it wasn't able to be seen.
I have never seen anything like this and have absolutely no explanation what it could have been in this rural area of high desert farmland--I have driven this stretch of highway hundreds of times in early evening, during the night.  Again, this light was massive in size, like somebody turned on a giant floodlight, each flash equidistant and at exact intervals.  The amount of distance it moved in such a short span of time is unexplainable.

I don't know what I saw, it really doesn't make any sense.  The video my wife made looks horrible with all the zooming in and out.  She was trying to get background in the shot so people could reference altitude.  Then they just stopped appearing.  
Like I said, just weird.

I called to my wife and asked her to bring me my camera while I continued to observe.  It was coming closer, but was still quite high, obviously I don’t know the size of the craft, but I would guess it was at 8000 to 10,000 feet altitude.
My wife called out that she could not find the camera (I was preparing to go on a trip the next day and had put it in a bag) so I started toward the house.  At that point I could tell the craft was slowing down.  As I walked toward our deck I nearly lost my balance and felt like I was becoming quite dizzy. summary: Bright white ball of light appeared in sky then shot toward ground, SSW direction.
description:
I was outside on my front porch smoking.  A bright star that looked to be changing color from white to red caught my eye.  
As I lifted my eyes to look directly at it, a bright white ball of light came out of nowhere and shot down toward toward the ground.  It didn't go straight down, rather it kind of arched down.  
Then before it could hit the ground, or at least right before I'd have lost view of it due to houses, the light just shut off.  
I got scared and ran into the house.  So I  don't know if it reappeared or not.  I'm writing this report just minutes after this happened.
I went straight to the Internet to see if anyone else reported seeing this and to see what a meteor falling looks like.  This was not a meteor.  
I found this website while looking up "bright white light falling from sky" and added my area in the search field.  
Thank you for this website, I'm grateful I'm able to talk about this to someone without feeling or being called crazy.

summary: Twelve dots moving in formation 20 miles southwest of Manhattan
description:
On 26 April 2015 at 7:10pm, in full daylight before the sun began to set, I saw a large grouping of 12 white or silver dots pass slowly east, beneath the daytime half moon.  
The leading three dots held steady in the shape of a large right triangle.  I could not tell if the other 9 held a pattern or moved around slightly, due to their faintness and some light wispy clouds.
Viewing them through binoculars did not reveal any details, still just bright dots.  I could not tell if they were mylar balloons, but they probably weren’t birds because the formation was moving too slowly.
The sighting lasted about five minutes as the lights moved slowly and very steadily toward the eastern horizon, until they were no longer visible.
I live about 20 miles southwest of Manhattan, and this was very similar to the mass sighting there on 13 October 2010.

I don't know if anyone else on the flight saw it but I know for a fact that I saw it.

The lights around the perimeter were rotating but I don't know if the craft itself was rotating or if it was just the lights.

It was blinking in a  • • - • • - patter if it was morse code.  Moving from White to red.
After looking at it for about a minute, I noticed another smaller object blinking in an on/off pattern moving closer to the first star like object.  I watched it until came to approximately the half way point, form its immediate position.  
At that point a formation of red lights appeared in an almost trapezoid pattern.  I then went to grab my dSLR camera with a telephoto lens, by the time I got back the lights and formations where gone.

It also seemed to increase and decrease its intensity and size of the light.  It lasted for about five minutes the just disappeared.

The way it moved can be compared to that of how humming birds fly.

They appeared to be cup shaped; in the sense that they looked like a very shallow tea cup turned upside down but with a slight oval shape as opposed to circular.  They seemed to glow rather than brightly radiate light.  They were a very pale yellow-white on the underside with a light that was soft and dim.

In fact, it was going faster than the jet!  It had descended and as I watched (with my prescription sunglasses on), from my car in a parking field, the object went from a northeasterly direction on my right towards the west on my left.
I grabbed for my phone to take a photo but decided to keep watching instead-the object became an orb joining another orb that spun around it.  The two continued on then met up with another 3 or 4 orbs encircling them before ascending and disappearing! This was near Roosevelt Field, Long Island, NY.  A Marines base is nearby.

Approximately 23:30 on the night of April 14th, 2015, my husband, mother-in-law, father-in-law and I were outside having a fire.  I noticed movement in the sky coming from the north/northeast and heading south.
For a split second, I thought I was seeing a flock of pure white birds moving in a flying "V" formation.  Upon further glance, I noticed there was no movement of wings and the formation stayed in a perfect "V" shape.  
This night the moon was covered by clouds, and there was no source of illumination nearby to explain the pure white color.  There were approximately 8-12 objects that were pure bright white in color, which were in the shape of a boomerang or chevron.  
The entire formation seemed to be moving very fast, and within a minute of spotting it, it just completely vanished out of sight.  Ten seconds later, my in-laws who were standing 20 feet behind us, noticed it completely vanish out of sight.  This all happened within 30-40 seconds.

Then I thought maybe it was a planet, but I noticed blinking that was happening around the circumference.  It appeared to have a mechanical blinking pattern.  So I grabbed my DSLR camera and began to film.
The object didn’t physically move in the sky, but appeared to be getting dimmer as time went on.  It could not have been a helicopter because it was too high in the sky, and it never changed position.
After about 15-20 minutes, the object completely faded away.  Was that a supernova?
Probably Venus.  PD

summary: 4 or 5 Amber orbs, 20 seconds apart approach Helena MT from the south then turn east over the capitol building.
description:
My son came in and said there was a amber orb in the sky.  We went to the porch facing east.  He pointed toward the Capitol building and said it was right there but we saw nothing.  
Then out of the south, another orb moving north towards us.  Over the capitol it changed direction and headed east.  No sound, just a sphere of amber-orange light.  
About 20 seconds later another orb flying  along the same flight path as the first ones.  We saw 4 in about 2 minutes.  
There was a thin low cloud bank to the east and as they past behind it you could still see the light but faded.  It was otherwise a clear sky, well lit, with no wind.  
I can estimate their speed at 200 to 400 MPH.  I can estimate their altitude at around 2500 FT.  They appeared to be climbing.  
All 4 or 5 seemed to follow each other's flight path and speed.  Flying N-NE in a straight line over the south hills, then turning east as they were about over the capitol building.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate.  PD

The craft were moving about fairly quickly, to and fro, left and right, up and down, getting quite close to each other at one point.  There was no noise, as from a helicopter.
I estimate the altitude varied from a maximum of 500 feet to a minimum of 100 feet when they dropped below the tree line, possible lower as I could no longer see them.  They did not disappear behind the trees because they were receding, but rather because they were dropping.
I estimate their distance at no more than ¾ mile.

On one the white lights remained orientated to the west and the red to the east, while the other seemed to do the same, with the direction orientated more north-south when that craft was to the east.…

summary: Several white orbs changing formation.

At first, it looked as if there were about 10 of these white, reflective objects in a perfectly circular formation.  I pointed it out to my mom, and she kept an eye on the objects while I was driving.  The objects quickly changed in formation appearing like a figure 8 and almost as if they had gained more of these white, reflective orbs.  
Once I got off the highway, we both had lost sight of the flying objects.  It was a clear day and these objects were flying very high up in the sky.

summary: Shiny 'white dots' over Saint Paul that changed shape right in front of me before disappearing.

I was looking out of the open window when, at first glance I assumed were a flock of seagulls flying way too high, began to appear in greater numbers (out of nowhere) and seemed to fill up a circular slowly moving shape.  It appeared to glisten, as you would expect to see water glistening on a bright sunny day.  They were very very high up and slowly more and more of these white "things" began to appear causing the circle to grow bigger.  I would say around 20 of these appearing in the circle.  As I went to say aloud to my husband, "what is that?" it just looked to almost deflate.  It then took on a long cigar like shape and moved forward before disappearing for good.  While in the cigar-like shape the image was dark and clear in the center.  There were no "white dots".  It completely changed form and was half the size of the previous circular form.  There is not one cloud in the sky.  There were no trees to block my view.  My window was down.  I saw this and it was like nothing I have ever seen.  I also have no good explanation of what it could have been.

summary: Several red lights moving toward the south/southwest, one by one over Collingswood, NJ

One of the other witnesses wondered aloud if they were some experimental craft on a test flight.  
They were coming from the horizon to the North/Northwest, and moving toward the South/Southwest.
The strangest part was that each one started to dim as they approached the zenith. and faded until they disappeared entirely by about 10 degrees past zenith from our position.
One witness took cell phone video of one of the lights.  
I could put you in touch with the person who took the video, if you contact me via email

Three orange lights forming an inverted triangle, no movement, no sound.
description:
I had gone outside later in the evening to view Betelgeuse, which was nearing the horizon and whose scintillations are quite lovely, as it glints in all colors.  Above Betelgeuse were Castor and Pollux, and in the space between them I noticed an red-colored light, star-like in appearance but not twinkling.  Soon it was joined by an identical second light source and then a third, the three of therm forming an inverted isosceles triangle that persisted for several minutes.  
I wondered if it were a reflection of headlights or other artificial light source, but there was nothing in the sky that would present a suitable reflecting surface.  The objects appeared to be getting nearer and brighter and then assumed a globular shape as opposed to pinpoints as observed earlier.  Their color also changed from red to amber. 
No sound was apparent.  I went inside to grab a star map, but the objects had vanished during my absence.

summary: Craft with 4 Red Straight Lined Flashing Lights
description:
Starting at 9:31pm.  Let the dog out into the back yard from our deck, and saw a red blinking light to the northeast, traveling from southeast due north.  The light was probably 1-1.5 of a miles away and approximately 300 feet in elevation.  As the Coeur d’ Alene airport is another mile north I figured it was a plane headed for the airport, although I’ve never seen a plane or helicopter approach from that direction.
No white or green navigation lights were visible.  Then one red flashing light then went to two flashing red lights, then three, then four, all in a straight line, not one under the craft, one on the rotor tail and one on nose, but all four lined up.  The flashing sequence changed from one blinking to two, then four, then three, then one, then all four at once.  At an arm’s length, the lights were half the size of my thumb at approximately 1-1.5 miles away.
I called my dad out on the deck and pointed it out.  He was amazed.  The craft made no noise and was moving slowly.  If it were a helicopter we would have heard it.  Unless it was a silent helicopter without any normal navigation lights on, but then 4 RED lights in a straight row?  I immediately thought someone had…

summary: Large, silent, light-absorbing black triangle seen slowly propelling parallel to the ground in Ellensburg, WA.
description:
Tonight, April 7, 2015, at approximately 9:00 pm (PST), I was walking west down the street, when I happened to look up.  I saw a black isosceles-shaped object approximately 15 feet wide with 3 whitish/yellowish lights at the points.  
The object was completely smooth, made no noise and seemed to not reflect light.  The object was approximately 20 feet in the air, slowly moving parallel to the ground towards the east.  
Although I never took my eyes off of the object, it suddenly disappeared after close to 5 seconds of observation.  
There were no nearby trees or buildings behind which the object could go. It just vanished.

summary: Bright Light Streaked Across Sky Moving North East

On April 7, at approximately 8:45 pm, in Cave Creek, AZ., I saw a bright object streak across the sky.  It moved in a straight line at a slight upward angle and vanished.  The object was travelling north/east.  The entire sighting lasted approximately 5 seconds.
The object was about 20 times bigger than what a planet appears to be in the sky.  I would guess its flight path to have occurred about 250 ft from the ground.
It seemed slower than a meteor but way faster than a plane.  I would describe the movement as streaking across the sky.

summary: Strange blue light circle shaped object flew across Florida sky in a bizzare pattern.

Then it suddenly slowed down a little, and went horizontal as it flew over head above my house, it moved extremely fast when it first shot across the sky, way too fast to be a plain or drone.

summary: Saw a stationary point of light, which was joined by two others forming a perfect triangle.
description:
I had gone out to watch Betelgeuse whose scintillations are lovely at this time of year when it is close to the horizon.  My attention was drawn to a point of light, red in color and steady in brightness.  It appeared in the area between Betelgeuse and Castor and Pollux. 
After a few moments, it was joined, one after another, by two identical points, the three forming a perfect triangle, two of which were separated by about the same distance as Castor and Pollux are from each other.  The base of the triangle was on the top with the third light underneath, closer to the horizon.  
As I watched, the three became larger, but their configuration did not vary, still a triangle but a little more orange in color and much brighter, resembling an amber-colored street lamp, i.e., a sodium vapor light. 
I dismissed the sighting initially, thinking they must have been artificial in nature; however, their appearance was arresting, as they seemed to be moving toward me, growing! ever brighter in intensity.  
I was transfixed, having some considerable familiarity with nature sky object, yet these were out of place, and I had no explanation for them.  
I went out the following morning and…

summary: Bright Spheres Of Light Observed Flying Formation in Access of 2,500 mph
description:

I did not see or hear any aircraft flying in the vicinity of the orb sighting for at least another 15 minutes.

summary: DISCO STAR -or- BLINKING STAR update and full report
description:
Ok, the "DISCO STAR" or "twinkling star," I just want to throw my observation in.  It is NOT a star, due to the fact that it does in fact MOVE in the sky and it is NOT a planet due to the fact that it is constantly blinking and changing colors.
With that said, it looks like a star to the unenlightened layman viewer just casually glancing at the sky.  It rises in the Eastern sky, and here in Northern Colorado, it is almost always visible (clouds/chemhaze/pollution/weather permitting) by 11pm and usually earlier shortly after nightfall.
I watch this thing religiously, and make sure to hold very still and look with both eyes directly at it for long enough to observe it move. It usually moves in a space in the sky no larger than a dime held at arms length, and maintains it's usual position. My father and I have, on one occasion, observed it being in one position and two hours later being in a position some 15-20 degrees North of that position.  This is anomalous movement and activity.
The color changing on it is PHENOMENAL.  Mostly what you can pick up is red, white, blue, and green, but it is in fact flashing everything in between when obsevered closely. I will speculate in the…

summary: Two Round Redish Orange Glowing Balls Seen Flying Over City.
description:
It was 11:15 pm, Sunday night, April 5, 2015, Medicine Hat, Alberta.  I went out in my backyard for a smoke.  I noticed out of the corner of my eyes, two round reddish orange balls, almost looked like roman candle fireworks.  
They both came into view over the houses,  They both went pretty straight up,  Then they started moving from the south to the north.  Both were same size, One stated going higher then the other.  About 1/4 size of the moon, alot bigger then the stars.  I seen them travel a good ways, before they faded in the distance towards Redcliff Alberta.  
It is hard to tell how close i was, it wasnt close enough to make out andy craft features,  All i could tell was the bottom looked to jet engines facing the ground.  No blinking lights, faster then an air plane which I see daily, just a steady glow.  I was very shocked, but very excited.  I have always been curious.  
I took two poor quality videos with my cell phone.  I didn't think right at the moment.  If I ever experience this again I will make one long video without zooming in and better reference points although it was dark out very poor picture quality.

It was a bright yellowish orange in the middle and very faintly there were smaller blinking lights on the side, from my view from the ground it appeared blueish.  Then when I went under an over pass the object disappeared, and my friend also said it suddenly vanished.

summary: Low flashing light traveling at high rate of speed.
description:
My girlfriend and I were on I-90 headed west when we both saw a low flashing light about 30-50 feet from the ground traveling at a high rate of speed flashing every second.  
The object was traveling parallel to the freeway heading east.  It was about 100-150 feet away from us as it passed by.  
I couldn't see a shape or any sign of a ship.  Just the flashing light and as it got close it was very dark behind the light.  
When the flashing light passed us, I looked and to see how far it was going,  I was that it keep flashing at the same speed still heading east.  The speed that it was traveling  was more then 150 mph.  I really want to know what I saw tonight.

summary: Silent firey orange spheres moving erratically and pulsating erratically.
description:
We saw 6 objects moving silently and slightly erratically from west to east.  They all started out appearing from below the horizon in the west, rising upward then turning to the east.  
Appeared to move in a sweeping arch toward the east and not in a straight line like a plane.  Their color varied from light orange to dark orange and one almost appeared to be on fire.  
I had my camera and zoomed in as much as I could and saw that they were all spheres, almost like small suns.  Their speed was not constant but varied and one moved side to side while moving westward.  One also was very close to another one but did not touch.  No sound at all yet they seemed to be fairly close to us.  
Lasted about 10 minutes in all.  First three appeared, then two then one by itself, all traveled in the same direction.  
When I zoomed in I could see no wings or anything attached to the spheres, only the lit up spheres themselves.

summary: Orange orb appears over Victoria BC.
description:
I was flying with my instructor (working on my commercial night rating) over Victoria around 845pm on April 6th.
We were at 2000ft heading Southbound pretty much directly over the Empress Hotel (Victoria Harbour).  To our 11o'clock and about 10 degrees above horizon we both saw a orange orb illuminate, make a 3/4 "C" shape movement towards the ground (reversed it's track), and immediately disappeared.
The entire phenomenon lasted only about a second.
It was not an airplane, it seemed close, and in my opinion it was at too shallow of an angle to be a meteorite.  It is also in an Fight Service Station advisory zone, so we would have immediately been advised of a traffic conflict if it was on radar.
It could have been in the distance, but it seemed very close (maybe 300 - 500m away).  I have seen falling stars before, as well as really unusual falling stars that delineate slightly due to naturally occurring conditions.  It DID not look that way.  The orange was so deeply intense, and unlike anything I have ever seen before.
I'm trying to find a rational answer to what we saw.

Then in the same space I saw a very bright light.  I thought it was too bright for a star and it seemed to be moving towards me.  I tried to film, but all I had was my cell phone and I am not good at using the video.  Anyway I did not get any pictures, just a black screen.

When the first faded it seemed to fly away from its low trajectory further into space, but I am not certain this was the case.  Certainly while they were visible they were easily viewed and appeared to track across the sky at a leisurely pace.

summary: Bright white orb over Essex, Maryland.
description:
On 04 April, 2015, at approximately 2100 hours, (9:00 PM), in Essex Maryland over looking the Chesapeake Bay, near Heart and Millers Island and viewing the night sky, the following was observed.  A very bright white circular light was observed traveling from the south to the north.  The object was at a great altitude, unknown as to the altitude level.  The object would resemble the likeness of the planet Venus, showing very brightly in the sky as an example to the size and shape, but much brighter.  I would estimate this object to have been traveling approximately 10,000 mph at least.  It covered the entire length of the sky in about 15 to 20 seconds.  This was not a meteor, as there was no tail etc.  This object covered the sky at an enormous rate of speed.
In this area and at the time of sitting, is Aberdeen Proving Ground, a US test site for weapons, etc..  Over the Proving Ground was the governments test blimp for the part of the entire east coast.  My understanding is that this government test blimp, records and monitors any and all aircraft, missiles etc, and anything in the air over the entire east coast.  If so, this test blimp had to pick this object up on their radar.

We first saw a group of 13 red objects coming from the North West and they appeared to by flying in several formations. The first few flew in a configuration that looked like the constellation Sagittarius with two vertical V shaped formations of 3 objects following this constellation resembling formation.
Since we live in the landing patterns for Philadelphia International Airport we are quite familiar with the heights, speeds and sounds of approaching, circling and departing aircraft.  There were no sounds associated with these objects and they seemed to fly past us at about 4-6k ft at about 400 mph. It was just hovering in one spot for about 30 minutes then the clouds got in my view but it was still there. At first he thought it was an aircraft, except for the speed and hovering.  The lights were floating next to each other and then a third light just appeared next to the first 2.

We watched for another few minutes before the light disappeared completely.

I observed a triangular pattern of three green lights.  They would have been positioned directly downward from the aircraft they were attached to.  They were of a flood light type, this is inconsistent with any search light, landing light or position marker lights to include night vision friendly directional lights.  The aircraft appeared to be in a left bank descending turn low on the tree line as if in a final approach of a landing.  In the air force it would be considered a tactical landing due to the harsh maneuver required to perform such a maneuver.   
Camp Lejeune is the property the aircraft was flying over.

summary: Three or four very large bright white tubular lights that were packed together and pulsating in unison.
description:
I was traveling on Interstate 95 in the southbound lane between exits 191 and 187, when I saw to my right, maybe one hundred feet above the tall trees, a group or cluster of three or four very large bright white tubular lights that were packed together (pointy end toward me) and pulsating in unison at a rate that I estimated to be twice per second.  
As we approached each other I stared intensely to see if I could make out the aerial vehicle that these lights were attached to, unfortunately I was unable to identify anything but the lights. 
My cruise control was set on seventy and the light cluster appeared to be traveling toward me at a reasonable speed.  
When we passed each other I looked in my truck’s side view mirror and was able to detect the object some distance behind me, still pulsating.  It is difficult now to say whether the object was traveling in my direction or was stationary. The object made no discernable noise, like a military aircraft does, and was clearly too close to the trees.

I took a video with my cell phone but they didn't turn out great but are still visible crossing the sky.  There was no apparent pattern and was certainly NOT one object.  They would come from what is approximately Travis AFB, and travel slowly across the sky, and then just fade away.  
Then a new group would come from the south and repeat the above.  
Interestingly, I appeared to be the only one looking at this phenomenon.  I google with my cell phone and found that approximately March 15, 2013, someone took a video which pretty much looked like what I saw.  Someone gave the opinion on this site that they were “lanterns”

summary: Strange orange light west of Algoma
description:
Saw an orange light slowly moving from the sky towards the ground in a straight line to the west of Algoma, WI.  I viewed the light through a pair of binoculars and it looked like a fireball.  After ten minutes it disappeared beyond the horizon line.
When I entered my house there was a static charge when I turned on the light switch.  This could be coincidental, but does not usually happen.

summary: 3 spheres that looked like children's bubbles flew across the sky in a triangle formation.
description: I was standing at a boat landing watching eagles soar, so my eyes were on the sky.  Movement caught my eye.  When I focused on it, I saw 3 spherical objects.  They looked exactly like a bubble blown by a child, but they were clearly very high in the sky.  Higher than the eagles.  They flew at a steady rate in a triangular formation, one in the lead and two slightly behind on either side.  They looked transparent but shiny.  I watched them until their transparency made it impossible to find them any longer.

summary: Cylindrical shaped object came to complete stop and ascended upwards.
description:
My mother and I were driving west on 44th when what appeared to be a low flying plane caught my mother's attention and she immediately told me to look.  I was able to watch it move at what appeared to be a 'gliding' descent in an area that has no airport.  
It was cylindrical in shape with a funky stabilizer tail.  The tail of the object is best described as a vertical stabilizer without the horizontal.  I watched it for approximately 1.5-2 seconds when with astonishment it comes to a complete stop and hovers for 3 seconds(?).  
I immediately reported to my mother who was driving that it stopped in the air.  As soon as I said that, the object in question began to ascend upwards into the sky for probably 2 seconds and stopped.   
It slowly moved forward and the next moment it was a dot in the near distance(probably over Boulder, Colorado). 
The near distance is probably 25-30 miles at least.  Or it disappeared in completeness and my eyes missed it?  
My mother and I are baffled to say the least.

summary: Witness provides no information about sighting.  PD
Wobbling orange ball light.
description:
Stepped out on my deck for a cigarette around 1:15 a.m., and saw a bright orange light.  Thought it was a plane, but it seemed to be wobbling and darting.  
It disappeared as it seemed to wobble into the distance.  
A moment later, it reappeared where I had originally seen it and followed a similar wobbling pattern.  
Again, it disappeared and reappeared a third time. 
No subsequent appearances.

summary: 3-22-15 Hudson Wis. discs.  40 minutes reddish orange pulsing lites from 6+/- craft. spinning noted. multiple positions. 3-26-15
description:
Saturday nite midnight..  My daughter called in a panic.  She said there was aliens all around her.  Said how afraid she was yelling can't u see them..  I went outside..  Couldn't believe what I was seeing..  
My wife jumped in her car and drove to where my daughter was..one craft was so close to her she cud see it spinning..were very bright like stars but all had reddish orange pulsing lites in the center..  I had my binoculars on them.  
They moved from spot to spot but kept positioning themselves like orion.  Then they would seperate all the while the pulsing lites continued.  Approximately 12:40 am the 22nd the clouds started to roll in and they all disappeared..  
I've seen many UFO's in my life..  But none like this.. none for this long...or that many together.. Was amazing

summary: Two orange balls hovering in alignment.
description:
Shooting white balls drops from one.  Shimmer out of sight.
Witness elects to provide no contact information.  PD

summary: I've seen this twice.
description:
Sitting in spa the black of night, I first saw this toward the beginning of winter heading north.  I've never seen a triangle plane that blended in the night sky with no sound, or fly that fast in my life.  
I saw it again this evening however it was flying south.  
Once again it was fast, low and no sound.  
I thought I was seeing things the first time it happened however I know now it's real.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Silent and slow moving orange lights in a loose group of 6-8 separate lights
description:
Deep orange lights, slow moving and glowy, at approximately the elevation of a helicopter, but I didn't hear any sounds, even though I was almost beneath them.  
They appeared to move in their own trajectories, near each other but not coordinated, and there were at least 6-8 of them. 
I was able to observe them for about five minutes, before they'd moved too far away for me to track.  Movement was generally southwest to northeast.

summary: I was taking long exposure pictures of Sirius/Orion's belt/Betelgeuse, when I noticed something flying near my field of view from the south.  At first glance it looked like a kite, triangular in…
description:
It flew northbound and when it was directly above me, I knew it wasn't a kite, drone, or bird. There were no lights on the object and no sound. 
It disappeared shortly after into the clouds (partly cloudy that night) and I heard the birds in that direction start to chirp wildly.
My camera was mid exposure on a 30 second shot and the object flew just outside the left side of the frame.  Unfortunately, even with an ultra wide 14mm lens on at the time, I was unable to capture anything. 
The whole event lasted no longer than 10 seconds.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Formation of orange lights flying over St charles.  Kept formation and flew east
description:
I was walking east on Elm street 1 block from Kings Highway.  I looked up and saw a formation of orange lights flying over appeared to be the Highway 370 bridge over the Missouri River area.  
There were several round orangish lights that had a formation.  They were not an equal distance apart but kept the same distance apart.  As I was trying to get my iPhone for pictures I noticed 2-3 cars noticed it and stopped in the road as well to watch.  The formation stayed in formed and either flew or drifted to the east.  We heard no engines or propellers of any kind.

summary: When walking the dog, I saw two red lights in the southern sky.  The lights at first were one above the other, and then they gradually moved around, sometimes circling each other, sometimes parallel,…
description:
The other one then got farther and farther away until it was lost in the clouds.  
They moved slowly, and there was no sound associated with this at all.

summary: Loud military jet precedes 2 fast-moving yellow-orange orbs
description:
My wife and I had a spectacular UFO sighting tonight.
We were all settled in for an episode of Vice (HBO), when I heard a loud whoosh, but I thought it was part of the soundtrack of Vice.  My wife exclaimed, "What the hell was that?" So she's looking out the window behind the couch explaining to me that the sound was coming from outside.  I followed her as she dashed out the front door.
I could still hear the trademark military jet-type whooshing sound in the distance.  It's sort of an irregular pulsating whoosh that starts suddenly and ends as suddenly as it started, and then repeats that maybe five or six times afterwards, the sound fading off.
So we're standing out front looking at the cloudless sky, and I'm telling her "You know, sometimes when military jets are sent low over areas they don't usually don't fly over, it means there was a UFO spotted in the area."  And not 30 seconds later, out of my left eye I see a light-orange-yellow spherical-shaped light moving NNE to SSW high in the SSW sky moving SSW through the constellation Orion.  
About a second later, as I'm alerting my wife to what I'm seeing, a second light that looked just like the first light appeared about 3" at…

summary: solid large disk
description: On friday 3/20/2015 while outside at poolside, on a perfect blue sky day i saw a large disk gun metal gray hover for 2-3 mins then zip away.  This was my first sighting i feel happy to report this

summary: Triangular UFOs spotted in Chester, West Virginia.
description:
Around 1:00am on the morning of March 20th, 2015, my two sons and myself saw a triangular shaped aircraft fly over the treeline behind our house.  It had three points.  The two points in the back were white and the point in the front was green.  
It hovered over the trees for about 30 seconds before flying away at an excellerated speed. 
Three minutes later we saw another one fly by, without stopping, and it looked identical to the one we saw only minutes before.

summary: Bright light, intense heat noise over Lansing MI
description:
At approximately 0400 03/20/15, I felt my house shake.  At first I thought we were having an earthquake.  
Following the shaking, sounds similar to video games appeared and this in turn was subsequently followed by a white, bright light and intense heat.  The light went through my bedroom window (which has super thick curtains in it) and I felt like it was burning me, similar to how one would feel when sunburned.  This sensation lasted maybe 3 minutes after whatever flew by my window had passed.  
I also felt like g-forces were being pulled down on me as it went overhead.

summary: Possibly UFO sighting Lansing, MI, east side.
description:
About 0400 this am, I woke up to my house shaking.  At first I thought we were having an earthquake.  
Then shortly thereafter, I heard what sounded like video game noises and this huge bright light shown through my bedroom window (despite there being dark curtains).  
After the bright light, there was this intense heat emitted and I literally felt like I was being burned.  
The entire episode lasted maybe 2 minutes, at the most, but it was the strangest thing.

summary: Me and my friend were having a sleepover on a rainy night and suddenly a flash came up in the sky.  We thought it was lighting so we kept talking.
description:
Soon after the white flash came up again and we were concerned.  
After a minute a greenish teal color flashed, and it looked as if the sun was shining...that is how bright it looked.

summary: 2 distinct starlike, amber large hovering "things" over and around Pikes Peak.
description:
6 legged star like shapes, 2.  first south of Pikes Peak, thought it was on the mountain like a prank, came in looked for anything online, nothing.  
Went back outside 25 minutes later thought it was gone, then realized it was closer to top of pikes peak.  Got another witness to see, and was amazed to see another one identical further away more north west. not a joke.  Flickering pulsing legs like a star but huge.  
Amber in color... hovering almost motionless yet apparently moving from previous location witnessed 25 minutes earlier.  
Roughly lat 38.83-105.00 log and further n/w for second one. no pics available as phone can't take a pic worth recording.

summary: Large bright orange ball of light slowly crossed sky, stopped, sped off very quickly out of view
description: I saw a very large bright orange ball move across the sky and stop. If I hold my arm straight out it was the size of my thumb nail.  It looked close by.  It stopped for about 10-15 seconds then sped off west toward mountains so fast it was gone in 2-3 seconds from sight.

summary: Hovering object above tree line, definitely not a plane or drone, very large.
description:
One hovering object above the swamp at the corner of Judd Road and Hattertown Road.  It was hovering over one place, moved slightly to the right then proceeded forward heading northeast.  The object was just above the tree line, with multiple lights on it.  
I was on my way home from a meeting, and only a few minutes from my house when I noticed the lights and originally thought it was a cell phone tower I had never noticed before, and slowed down and stopped when I noticed that it was in fact moving.  
I did not open the car windows or get out to try and listen for any noise.

summary: Strange flickering lights appeared in Merced Co., that appeard to be attatched in groups by threads of light, just before vanishing.
description:
My neighbor had been outside with me last night (3/20/15) and as we were smoking our cigarettes.  She was stuck on a star....the only one in the whole sky, and it appeared to change colors.  
Then tonight my brother comes knocking shortly after midnight and I happen to look at the sky and saw a crazy round like barrier or out line in the sky being created by the lights.  Each light moved in a slow sway motions, reflecting an almost completely transparent threat like light, which connect them in specified groups.  Each time we heard the strange kind of baritone rumble in the sky only a few would zip full speed ahead and vanquish.  
I made an attempt to photograph on laptop but my laptop shut down every time I took it outside.
We have corrected the time and date above.  We are uncertain as to whether this is intended as a serious-minded report.  Contact information for source is defective.  PD

summary: 4 crafts lights straight in row.  Then 2 turned off, then 5 min later, the other 2 turned off.
description: Coming fron Newark Airport area, 4 lights straight, then disappeared.  Did not look like air craft with blinking lights.

summary: 2 big, white lights hovering over Carbondale, and 5 helicopters circling around them.
description:
I was driving north from Makanda to Carbondale at 8:15 pm.  About a mile north of the south end of Union Hill, I saw some lights in the sky to the north of me.  2 large white lights floating motionless in the sky, and some smaller colored lights that appeared to be helicopters.
The white lights were, from my vantage, about 5 degrees above the horizon.  Apparently floating 500' above Hwy 13, or somewhere to the north of Hwy 13.  The light on the left was floating about 200' higher than they one on the right (This is a very rough estimate).  They were bright, big, glowing, white.
The helicopters were moving to the left and right, back and forth, maybe circling.  2 were flying around near the SIU farms, west of McLafferty and South of Chataqua.  The other 3 were roving around in the vicinity of the 2 white lights.
I was driving into Carbondale to visit a friend.  From his house I could see the white lights and 1 helicopter.  
I went inside his house for 2 minutes and dragged him outside to see.  He saw the helicopter.  The Light seemed to have moved a bit when I saw it again, it had drifted a little lower, partially hidden by trees and buildings.
I went inside.  Came back out 15…

summary: Large Bright Red Orb/Light Over Van Nuys/Burbank.
description:
While driving home noticed a VERY bright red light in sky towards Van Nuys or Burbank.   Kept an eye on it while I pulled onto my street.  It appeared to be moving and getting closer.  
Got home and it was still there. Got out of car and continued to watch.  Bright Red Light was now hovering in place.  It appeared to be at low altitude, like one would see the LAPD helicopter.  But this had No noise nor did it have any of the other obvious helicopter indicators.  
Then the light got small while it was hovering.  A moment later it was as if someone turned off the light.   Gone!
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Bright oval disc shaped stationery object in the sky
description:
Me and my wife were about to enter our local ShopRite supermarket, when we saw a very bright oval/disc shaped object in the sky.  At first I thought it was an airplane but it was quite large and wasn't moving so I pointed it out to my wife.  There were moving clouds below where the object was and we stood for a while to see whether the object moved or not.  The object remained stationery for about 5 mins, and we were able to take a picture of it with her smartphone.
I should mention that I noticed 3 lights in a triangle around the same area the night before but unfortunately I do not have reliable witnesses of that event.  I was with 3 people who refused to even look at the sky when I brought it to their attention.

summary: Observed a silvery white cigar shaped object, very high in the sky, no wings, no contrails, move steadily from north to south.
Bright light flying slowly shows a triangle craft at very slow speeds over Wheaton, Illinois.
description:
We were driving east on Roosevelt Road and spotted a very bright white light that looked to be way off in the distance.  
Within a minute we were along side the craft to the North of Roosevelt Rd.  Besides the very bright white lights we could now see a V or triangle shape.  There were two flashing white lights on either side with a couple red lights in the middle section.  
The craft was heading west at either a vey slow speed or stopped.  It did not resemble a helicopter at all.

summary: Bright red orb spinning in circles then shooting a mile in a matter or seconds.
description: Driving down county road 7, I saw a strange red light that looked like a cellphone tower but it was in a spot where there wasn't any.  I pulled to the side of the road and it went from where I saw it to a few miles in the matter of a second.  It then started doing circles around 20 times then stopped.  It then zigzaged from rush point store to Cambridge within 5 seconds.

summary: V formation seen over Norfolk, Virginia
description:
I went outside for a cigarette.  Looked up to the stars like I always do.  I thought it was a wisp of cloud moving, but as I kept watching it was a formation of white dots moving across the sky.  I kept watching to count about 20 of these white "star-like" points of light.  They were moving in a loose line but as i watched i could count two next to each other as they slowly moved closer in to a distinct "V" formation.  At some points it was hard to count them because it looked as if they over lapped.  
The formation moved at an accelerated airplane speed.  I was facing North-North-East as they moved North-North-West.  
After about 12 seconds they disappeared out of side over a tree and far away.  From my 60 degree angle it appeared that they were closer to to the Norfolk Naval Base as i did not see them over-head.  If this was a flock of geese i dont know why it was so easy to spot them and why they were lit up.

summary: Was driving down Green Tree St., Palmer.  Was looking at some northern lights, which was mild compared to the night before.
description:
I seen an object that looked just like a star moving..  At first thought, I thought it was a satellite, but realized, after years of seeing them, it was moving to fast, and it was too bright.  Covering a distance that is impossible for any of our aircraft that the public know about..so I thought maybe a meteorite, until it maneuvered a course correction faster than anything I know about it.  My fiance saw it after the change in direction.  
Then it seem to fade out as it was moving faster than anything I've seen.  But came back into sight again moving towards the horizon within seconds…  
iv never reported anything like this, and I'm kinda in shock.. i hope, someone else saw this, Please report it.

summary: Red/blue orb flying sporadically above Redwood City.
description:
I arrived home late from dinner Wednesday night at 11:30pm.  As I took the garbage cans outside, I just happened to look up at the clear sky.  To the northwest, close to above the 280 freeway, I saw a blue bright orb.  As I saw it, it steadily moved in the opposite flow of airplanes circling around to land at SFO.  
It then appeared to move vertically down, hover, then vertically back up.  The blue light then turned bright red.  It was bright enough to create a halo or orb around the object.  
The now red light ascended and moved horizontally across the sky.  Definitely not an airplane or heli.  I also thought drone, but way to big and fast unless it was a huge commercial drone.  Drones don't also make them self visible as bright blue/red lights.  The red light moved all directions in the sky very rapidly.  
After about 5 minutes of tracking it across the sky.  It seemed to go straight down again and eventually went behind the Canada College parking lot bright lights we can see from our place.  
I'm excited in what I saw and took some video.  Never seen anything like this before.  I always look up at night and finally caught something I couldn't identity.  I only hope others saw…

summary: I see the same craft every night the are circle and glow different colors and they respond to a green laser light.  they are in a formation at times also but I see them every clear night we have

summary: Bright colored flashing strobe lights in an oval shape that turned West and North remaining in one place
description:
I noticed one year back someone reported seeing in nearby Rockland what I saw:  
This was a flashing object in the sky.  The flashes were bright and blue/white light. (I also saw red as well)  The light pattern was irregular but there did appear to be strobes in an irregular fashion.  
The light being emitted appeared to stay in one spot the entire time.  (I saw the shape turn to the West then back to the North...the face of the object had the lights, you could not see them when the object turned)  
I went to get binoculars to view. It did not appear man made.  I was not looking when it disappeared.  I plan to ask in town whether anyone else saw this.  It was over the St. George River between St. George and Cushing Peninsulas.

summary: Star like object, did not move, lights did not flash, there were probably at least 8 lights on it.
description:
I always look outside before I go to bed, and at 10 pm, I looked out and saw a large star like shape, dominantly red with white lights across Puget Sound looking toward Gig Harbor, (we are on the ridge looking over at Gig Harbor with Puget Sound between it).   
The UFO did not move, but the lights glowed, as I watched for 10 minutes, and then went to bed.  
I was a bit frightened as I had not seen anything like this before and did not go outside.  I thought it was a clear night, thought I did not see any stars, only the object in the sky.  I am quite sure it was not a star.  It was quite large.  
I am continuing to look outside each night in hope of seeing this object again.

summary: Craft was at 20,000 ft. cleared valley in 15 sec.  Bright white light.
description: Looking at sky bridge circular light no red flashing running light was about 15-20,000 feet going west to east cleared valley in less than 15 seconds.

summary: Bright light-large-moving or rotating up-down in sky.  Closer look shown red/white lights. no noise heard.  V shape at times.
description:
I had walked from a neighbors home here, mountain region.  Saw bright roundish large light.  Many stars out, but this one was rotating.  Binocular view shown object changing colors (white-red)-shape became V shaped or lights illuminated the wings, then back to original round shape.  Moving slowly below cloud line.  Followed it for as long as it appeared in view over mountain range.
We are friends who have known each other over 15 years.  We did take a picture with phone.  Have never seen any object in sky at the location before.  Lived here over 40 years.

summary: Appeared to be one craft traveling slowly at first and then rapidly left my sight.  One bright white light in the front, followed by two red lights horizontally opposed quite a distance from the…
description:
The craft was almost silent...I could not tell if I was hearing it or another craft off in the distance.  It appeared to be very low when first sighted, but higher just before it disappeared. 
My friend and I were on my driveway behind my house and it was dark.

summary: Two horizontal rows of six lights each hovering about seventy-five feet in the air; seen for about ten minutes.
description:
I was returning home from church.  I had turned off of Eastown Rd. onto Allentown Rd. heading East.  I noticed what appeared to be two horizontal rows of six lights each hovering in the air about 75 feet up.  
As I got closer I realized that it was hovering above the area behind the Tom Ahl Chevrolet dealership on Allentown Rd.  The upper lights on each end would flash intermittently.  I turned into the Walmart parking lot across the road to get a better look.  
When I exited my vehicle the object was gone.  Other than a cart pickup who was headed in with a string of carts I was the only person in the parking lot.

summary: A V-shaped craft with a total of 4 yellow lights and 1 red light flew around a residential area.  Landed in nearby woods.
description:
I was walking my dog when all of a sudden this thing flew by it was about the size of a car and it was v shaped.  
It had 2 yellow lights on the front and 2 yellow lights on the back with a red light in the middle 
it was making a low siren sound and I believed at first that it was an aircraft in distress.  
It made a circle over head and then hovered before landing a bit away in the woods.  
I live near a naval base, so that could be an explanation but its behavior was strange for a naval craft, especially being near a residential area and the hovering.

location: Wappingers Falls (over The Hudson River), NY, USA
summary: UFO
description:
Bright light over the Hudson.  My third time observing it as it stays up in the sky for several hours, and then drifts dolly over mountains.  I've seen it change color as it moves behind mountains.  
I live directly across Orange County and have a River view. Still there as I speak.
Star??  PD

summary: It seemed fiery orange and white light bobbing in the sky not all over more like hovering.....seriously hard to describe.
description:
It is hard to describe, it seemed to look distorted because of the lights. It was, for the most part, stationary but seemed to move to the left and right or, maybe, if you can imagine like a bobber in the water when you fish.  It of course had many lights, my camera would not focus on it and the binoculars seemed to make it look stranger.  It did look like an egg almost at first, with stringy looking stuff being the lights, I assume.  It looked 3D and like it had craters or something but perfectly round and different sizes.  When I tried to make it focus better, it seemed like maybe it is in my head or something but when I was not zoomed in all the way, it looked more like a bright saucer.  I would think this was a planet but no way was it up in the sky that high.
It seemed very close, and I do wonder how something could be in our atmosphere and go unnoticed?  I cannot describe what I saw, because, even though I saw it, I cannot figure out what it was.  It feels like a head game at this point, maybe even a science project, but something that size I doubt someone could pull it off.  I think it must be a planet, but I will have a hard time convincing myself of that.  It is by far…

summary: NJ parkway south exit 109.  White glow from sky.

summary: Vapor trail rising vertically like a rocket, then leveled off at a very high altitude.  This appears to be a jet aircraft.  As it proceeded South there was another aircraft following close which was…
Started out like a narrow vertical smoke stream, then separated into two sections.  The upper section move upward then changed form,then circled the lower section that formed into a triangler shape.

Possible over Hermisto, Oregon, or further west.  We watched it until the sun set and its distance made it fade away.

summary: Metalic Pyramid like object seen over Tampa Florida Downtown in daylight.
description:
I'm a 31 year old female.  I Spotted a highly reflective, metallic pyramid like object hovering around the Hotel Floridan in day light at Tampa Downtown.  Appeared to be 5x5 feet in height and width.  
The object rotated slowly showing it's flat metallic surfaces, reflecting the sun on its panels.  I watched it slowly move down from the sky in the distance towards the building 15 floors up from my apartment.  
At first I thought it was a helicopter but as it got closer, I noticed it looked nothing like it.  I then tried to see if it was a balloon.  But when I saw it move in a zig zag movement going up, down, left and right, I scratched that idea too.  I watched it move up and down along the building and then quickly move off into the horizon, changing its speed as it eventually zipped upwards into the sky.  I'm hoping other's saw this object too. Very strange.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Loud fog horn like sound, and huge gusts of wind and a large triangular object flying towards the atmosphere. Major static in the air.
description:
I was walking home from about 2-3 blocks away and as I reached our neighbors house, out of nowhere an ear piercing horn sounded.  If I had to describe it, I would say a Fog Horn would best imitate it. 
At first I thought it was one of my neighbors mowing their lawn and I started to look around my street.  Not a single person was outside of their house. Some houses didn’t even have cars in the driveway.  The horn kept getting louder as I reached the bottom of our driveway and I could hear my dog going ballistic from inside my home.  Around two seconds later I felt my hair stand up and my sweatpants start to cling to my legs as I was about to be struck by lightning.  I didn’t mind that as much as the horn though.  I eventually thought that it could have been a helicopter or a plane flying overhead.  There were only two things wrong with that idea.  The first was that the sound’s “tune” didn’t increase nor decrease as it kept a very low horn like sound.  The second thing that was wrong with my theory was that when I looked up to check to see if it was actually a plane or a helicopter, I saw the actual UFO.  It was not like anything I had ever seen before.  I saw it for a good 4-5…

summary: Glendale California where the shape ships come for one guy
description: On the nite of 3-18-2015 I saw two lights moving from right to left and a circle motion on the top of the mountain at forest lawn in glendale from my window facing my back yard where my bedroom is located in da adress  XXXXX oakridge dr glendale ca 91205.  About 45 min later I saw the shining light on the right side of the two that where there two located in the sky I got a chance to take some pictures befor the ufo became a image that looked like a quarter moon blue in color the took off in to the sky by becoming a blue lighting linage and diapering in to the dark sky I still have the pictures in my phone that I can show you I also called 211 the next day and was connected to a company named KFI in Los angeles where they gave me a confemation # 2931472 I need someone in Los Angeles to investigate this sighting that I had I think I might of been abducted to please give me a call back at 818-XXX-XXXX thank you for your time and effort

summary: Object in sky causes disturbances, darts off into space.
description:
Strange activity throughout the day, such as WiFi interference, cable TV Interference, lots of airplanes & such, BUT one such odd event was a triangular shaped objects (below radar) in the sky that was motionless, but had a mostly red glow with green hue to it.  
to it, after a short period, one made a u-turn & darted off towards Charlotte, & the other object lowered down & hovered, once the 1st one was gone, the other one stayed behind, shortly after the 1st one left, something came back from the direction that the 1st one went to, but this time it was a red ball, similar to a firework & and it appeared to have landed to across the highway,not to be seen again.after that, the 2nd one was gone.  
my son, his wife, my husband, and our neighbors, AND their friends saw this.

summary: Fast moving light which turned...a lot.
description:
This past Tuesday I was out back, having let the dogs out one last time when I noticed that the sky was uncommonly clear.  So much so that the stars were twinkling.  
I then noticed what I first thought was a satellite because of its altitude and that it was also sparkling.
A moment later I changed my mind because it was moving too fast.  That and it changed its course.  Several times. In ways that a plane can’t.  There’s also that satellites don’t change course.

I saw no sign of the aurora but while facing west with my house behind me I noticed an object come over the house, heading east to west.  I could not discern its altitude or size but it was high, certainly not a low-flying object.  It appeared in the sky to be the size of a dime (I know that’s of no help in ascertaining actual size but that’s how much of the sky it seemed to cover).  
It was the shape of a squat comet, perfectly round at the front with a stubby tail.  It was an electric green and emitted light as if it were…
