At approximately midnight and about 15-20 minutes after midnight (New Year's), 6 or 7 elongated reddish orange lights moved slowly across the sky from East to West.  With binoculars the shape of each object seemed to be elongated rectangular with an aura of soft white light surrounding the top in an arc shape.  
The first two lights at first appeared to be large wingtip lights but then several other lights followed the first two in a one-by-one procession.  There was no sound, they moved rather slowly, no jerking and it was difficult to determine how high up in the sky the objects flew.  
At the exact point in the sky, overhead from the observation location, each light was no longer visible (faded/blinked out) when it arrived at that point.  The lights were spaced apart, not side by side except for the first two observed.  They did not travel in a line, but were staggered in formation.  
No photo was taken because no smartphone or camera available with night photo capacity.  
A map and possibly drawing will be forwarded via email to ufocntr@nwlink.com.

You could not hear any sound from them, (yes there were fireworks going off but during the quiet pause times no sound from the craft).  I had my Sony handycam and was trying to video them with normal and nightshot but could see no details.

description:

As we look into the sky to gaze at a fireworks display, something catches my eye beyond the show.  	A bright orange light shines in the distance.  It's brighter than Venus by comparison, glowing a dull yet vibrant orange.  
Fireworks dissipate over time while this unidentified light glimmers behind.  We stare in some mild form of disbelief.  Tears are coming out of my eyes for no particular reason I can fathom.  The light sits, unwavering.
	My first thought was that it might be a paper lantern.  Being a holiday it seemed likely that someone might light off a few.  It's possible that a paper lantern could have been caught in an inversion current leaving it in a point of temporary stasis.  From experience we know what paper lanterns look like however, regardless of distance.  The light being emitted was far to bright to be a little ball of fire in a bag.
	After a few minutes the object begins to move away from us, getting…

summary: Captured on video a UFO hovering over us as we watched the fireworks on New Years Eve.

At midnight on December 31 2015, we were watching the fireworks on New Year's eve downtown, I was actually video recording the event on my iPhone 6.  
When the fireworks began everyone was cheering, when I heard multiple people around me saying what the hell is that?  I looked to my right, and above us a UFO came across the night sky, hovering red and green lights.
It was round with green lights one one side but it had red lights on the other side of it, it flashed in both colors, at first my sister claimed it was the news filming the event, but the people including myself said that not a helicopter, it maneuvered across than accented up and than down, it turned and began trailing back.
This isn't the first time I recorded this red and green flashing light UFO.  Last year, on Fourth of July, I recorded a craft with this same descriptions at a fireworks display going off. summary: Seen 7 orange/red fireballs in central Florida on New Years
description:
Looking up at the night sky in central Florida, my wife and I saw 7 orange fireballs in the sky at roughly 15000-20000 ft. altitude.  There was 1 at first and we thought an airplane had an engine on fire, until the other 6 in a group form came in behind what I'm gonna call the lead fireball.  
They were headed south/southwest.  Could see the orange/red flame for quite a while until it faded from site.  
I don't know what these things were, I'm wondering if I should be concerned?  Seems people are seeing these "fireballs" all over the US. does anyone know what these are for sure.  It's NOT a helicopter, airplane, or from the military.  
We live about 20 min. from OIA and can hear those jet engines pretty clear, these "fireballs" were silent, no noise of any kind.

summary: Went out to watch the fire works at midnight.  Saw the usual aerial fireworks but then saw 2 bright red lights traveling from the west and then turning in a wide arc to the south.  At first I thought…
description:
I have lived less than 2 miles from the Eugene airport for the past 23 years.  I have seen private airplanes, private jets, commercial jets, cargo jets, navy sub killer aircraft conducting touch and go training flights, and a wide variety of military jets taking off after re-fueling on north to south trajectories.  I know all of the trajectories for all of the aircraft that fly over or around my home and, at times, what time of day I can expect to see particular airlines.  I am can distinguish the difference between night time aircraft lights and landing lights between fixed wing and jet aircraft.  I also know the sound that all of them make.  
Tonight I neither heard nor saw anything I have ever experienced.  There were none of the usual stro! bing lig hts, throbbing engine sounds, or jet sounds.  I have also seen military jets climbing at night.  Their after burners have never looked red.  What I saw and heard were bright red lights that fluctuated minimally and felt, but did not hear, a slight bass hum.   
Conditions were clear, 23 degrees F, no clouds, and a bright half moon in the sky.  I have never seen any thing like this in my 55 years on the planet.

description: Drove from house to our workshop (approx. 500ft) to start a fire.  Saw 3 bright red lights moving relatively slowely, heading south (close to I-75).  2 of the red lights were close to each other, while the 3rd red light trailed at some distance.  I jumped out of the truck & pulled out my phone & began recording; simultaniousely telling my girlfriend to look at the sky.  At that time the trailing 3rd light zoomed up to the first 2 lights, which created a perfect triangle.  She started freaking out, so we went back up to the house.  I ran to tell my dad & we went back outside, but the lights were gone (approx. 2 minutes after first sighting).  I pulled my phone out to show the video but nothing was recorded.  We didn't actually see any type of saucer or craft, just bright red lights that each seemed to be an individual craft.

summary: Orange glowing domed shaped disks with red lights around the bottom of each.
description:
Saw a whole fleet of domed shaped saucers all aglow in orange, with red lights around the bottom.  
They were flying due east towards the ocean.  They kept coming.  I stopped counting at 20.  
They were first headed right over our house, and then also to the far right.  There was so many, me, my daughter and son couldn't count them all.  
I tried to take pictures with my Vivitar camera.  They didn't come out as clearly as we could see them with our eyes.  We were in awe!
